scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
question: Would an eligible enterprise that has availed of incentives or subsidies under any other state government incentive scheme be eligible for benefits under the Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in the Powerloom Sector for other specified items?

scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
question: How does the Directorate of Textiles determine the eligibility of enterprises for projects financed from their own resources?

scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
question: What is an “Approved project”?

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What is the Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre (JRCPC) scheme?
answer: The JRCPC scheme is an initiative by the National Jute Board (NJB) to set up jute training and production centres across India in collaboration with experienced agencies. It aims to promote jute diversification, empower women, and generate sustainable employment through the manufacturing of Jute Diversified Products (JDPs).

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: Who can apply to set up a JRCPC?
answer: Bonafide Indian agencies such as registered jute entrepreneurs, NGOs, cooperative societies, federations, PSUs, exporters, and other organizations with at least three years of experience in jute-related training, production, or marketing are eligible. Preference is given to those experienced in Women SHG development and the textile/handloom/handicrafts sector.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What are the main benefits of the JRCPC scheme?
answer: - Promotes eco-friendly jute alternatives to plastic | - Provides training, raw material, design, and marketing support | - Generates sustainable employment for 10,800+ beneficiaries | - Empowers women (over 70% of trainees will be women) | - Offers backward and forward linkages for JDPs | - Supports inmates of correctional homes and families of security personnel

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: Who are the intended beneficiaries of the training and support under JRCPC?
answer: Potential beneficiaries include artisans, women self-help groups (WSHGs), NGOs, cooperative society members, Trusts, correctional home inmates, and families of Police/Para-Military/Armed Forces Welfare Societies interested in JDP production.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What are the infrastructure requirements for collaborating agencies?
answer: The agency must have: | - An office of at least 250 sq. ft.- A JRCPC space of at least 500 sq. ft.- Basic amenities like telephone, computer/laptop, and email facilities

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: How many people are expected to be trained under the scheme?
answer: The scheme targets training around 18,000 individuals in the production of Jute Diversified Products, out of which more than 70% will be women.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What is the application process for interested agencies?
answer: Applications must be submitted online via the NJB website (https://www.jute.com), followed by the submission of hard copies with required documents to the Head or Regional Office of NJB as per jurisdiction.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What documents are required for the application?
answer: Some key documents include: | - Ownership document (MoU/ AoA of Companies/ Registered Deed of Partnership/ Registration of Societies (or) Trade License, etc., and Adhaar Card / Address Proof of the authorized representative of the agency). | - Income Tax Return for last financial year along with PAN number | - Details of PAN, GST returns for the last 3 financial years | - Annual Reports for last three financial years | - Audited financial statements for last three years | - Any other documents establishing the credential of the agency | - Other supporting documents ( Project experience certificates etc.) | - Recommendation from Dist. Magistrate/Dist. Collector/DIC/ NABARD/ DRDA/BDO may be submitted | - Details of experience in Trainings, Designing/ Product development, Production and Marketing of JDP sector including Award Won and details of its creativity, work done in the past in connection to the scope of the work suggested. | - Proof of Experience and handling relevant activities to be mentioned; | - An Concept / Approach note, (As per guidelines indicated below) highlighting the need of the quality training focusing on development of Jute Diversified Sector through product identification, quality training with design inputs, bulk production and market sales, promotion of these JDPs in domestic and international market. | - An Undertaking from the Agency, that the JRCPC, if allotted, will be operated for atleast one year until and unless terminated by NJB earlier.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What kind of training will be provided at the JRCPCs?
answer: Training will focus on the design, development, production, and marketing of JDPs. It will include quality training with design inputs, product identification, and promotion strategies for domestic and international markets.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: How does the scheme support the marketing of JDPs?
answer: The scheme offers forward linkages by facilitating sales through Jute Retail Outlets, NJB-organized fairs, and exhibitions, and backward linkages by ensuring supply of raw materials through JRMB (Jute Raw Material Bank).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the JRF program?
answer: The JRF program is a fellowship program that provides financial support to students who are pursuing doctoral research in biotechnology and life sciences. The program is funded by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: Who is eligible for the JRF program?
answer: - Be an Indian national. | - Have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university. | - Have a valid BET score.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the application process for the JRF program?
answer: To apply for the JRF program, you must first qualify in the Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET). The BET is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the DBT once a year. | Once you have qualified in the BET, you can apply for the JRF program online. The online application process typically opens in the month of July and closes in the month of August.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What documents are required for the RF program?
answer: - BET exam scorecard. | - Research proposal. | - No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer (if applicable). | - Personal details and educational qualifications. | - Category certificate (if applicable). | - Persons with Disability (PWD) certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the selection process for the JRF program?
answer: - BET exam score | - Research proposal | - Interview performance

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the duration of the JRF program?
answer: The JRF program is a five-year program.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the fellowship amount for the JRF program?
answer: The fellowship amount for the JRF program is [?]31,000 per month for the first two years and [?]35,000 per month for the remaining three years.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What are the career prospects after completing the JRF program?
answer: After completing the JRF program, you can pursue a career in research, academia, industry, or government. Some of the specific job roles that you may be eligible for include: | Research scientist | Professor | Lecturer | Science communicator | Technical writer | Patent agent | Regulatory affairs specialist | Quality assurance manager | Business development manager

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What are the responsibilities of a JRF fellow?
answer: The responsibilities of a JRF fellow include: | Conducting research in biotechnology or a related field | Publishing research papers in peer-reviewed journals | Presenting research findings at conferences and seminars | Completing PhD degree within the stipulated time frame

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals
question: How Many Slots Are Available Under The Scheme For Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And For Research Associateship (RA)?
answer: The number of slots available under the scheme is 20 for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and 7 for Research Associateship (RA).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Is this scheme a crop insurance scheme?
answer: No, this scheme is not a crop insurance scheme but a compensation scheme to provide financial assistance directly to farmers in case of crop damage.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What are the objectives of the scheme?
answer: The objectives are to provide financial assistance to affected farmers, strengthen their income, ensure financial flow for agricultural work, and support food security, crop diversification, rapid growth, and competition in agriculture.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
answer: Eligible applicants are permanent residents of Jharkhand who are small or marginal farmers, 'Raiyat' or 'Bataidaar' farmers, aged at least 18 years, with a valid Aadhaar Number, and possess requisite land papers.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What types of natural calamities are covered under the scheme?
answer: The scheme covers flood, waterlogging, earthquake, volcanic eruption, landslide, drought or dry winds, widespread epidemic, naturally caught fire, thunderstorm, storm, torrential rain, and cyclone.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What risks are not considered under the scheme?
answer: Losses caused by war/nuclear risks, malicious losses, preventable risks such as unscientific farming practices, and crop loss due to wild animal attacks are not covered under the scheme.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What benefits are provided under the scheme?
answer: Financial assistance of [?]3,000 per acre (for 30-50% crop loss) and [?]4,000 per acre (for >50% crop loss) is provided, up to a maximum of 5 acres.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Are both Kharif and Rabi season crops covered?
answer: Yes, both Kharif (Paddy & Maize) and Rabi (Wheat, Mustard, Gram, and Potato) season crops are covered under this scheme.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Do farmers need to pay any premium for this scheme?
answer: No, farmers do not need to pay any crop insurance premium under this scheme.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Who are excluded from participating in this scheme?
answer: Exclusions include former and present members of Rajya Sabha/Lok Sabha/Legislative Assembly, ministers, chairpersons of municipal bodies/Zilla Parishad, certain government employees, pensioners with monthly pensions of [?]10,000 or more, income tax payers, and practicing professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, and architects.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: How can farmers apply for the scheme?
answer: Farmers can apply by visiting the official website of the Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana at https://jrfry.jharkhand.gov.in/.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Are farmers cultivating on government or non-majorua land eligible?
answer: Yes, farmers cultivating on such lands with lease or settlement documents from the Revenue Department are eligible.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: Is the scheme voluntary for farmers?
answer: Yes, participation in the scheme is voluntary for all farmers.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What is the minimum crop loss required to receive assistance?
answer: Farmers must have a crop loss of at least 20% to receive assistance under this scheme.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: How much agricultural land can be covered under the scheme?
answer: Farmers can avail benefits for agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 10 decimals to a maximum of 5 acres.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
question: What if a farmer faces losses due to wild animal attacks?
answer: Losses due to wild animal attacks are not covered under this scheme but under the schemes of the Forest, Environment and Climate Change Department, Government of Jharkhand.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences

answer: The objective is to provide opportunities for NET-JRF qualified candidates to undertake advanced research leading to M.Phil./Ph.D. degrees in Humanities, Social Sciences, Languages, and Sciences.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: Who is eligible for the UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) scheme?
answer: The scheme is open to candidates who qualify for the National Eligibility Test (NET-JRF) conducted by UGC or the UGC-CSIR joint test. However, qualifying for these tests does not automatically grant a fellowship.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: What is the fellowship amount under the JRF scheme?
answer: JRF: [?]37,000 per month (for the first two years). | SRF: [?]42,000 per month (for the remaining tenure).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: What is the contingency grant for JRF and SRF scholars?
answer: For Humanities & Social Sciences: | [?]10,000 per annum (JRF) | [?]20,500 per annum (SRF) | For Science Scholars: | [?]12,000 per annum (JRF) | [?]25,000 per annum (SRF)

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: Is Housing Rent Allowance (HRA) provided under the fellowship?
answer: Yes, HRA is provided as per Government of India norms.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: Are medical expenses covered under the fellowship?
answer: No separate or fixed medical assistance is provided, but fellows can avail medical facilities available at their institution, university, or college.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: What is the leave policy for JRF and SRF scholars?
answer: Fellows are entitled to a maximum period of 30 days of leave in a year in addition to public holidays. They are not entitled to any other vacations.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: Can The Candidate Take Maternity Leave?
answer: Yes, the candidates are eligible for maternity/paternity leave as per Govt. of India norms issued from time to time at full rates of fellowship once during the tenure of their award.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: What Is ‘Intermittent Break’?
answer: Besides maternity/paternity leave, 'Intermittent Break' for a maximum period of 1 year may also be permissible to the women candidates. The leave can be availed 3 times during the entire period of the fellowship. However, the total duration of leave shall not exceed one year. This Flexi Time period should not be counted towards the tenure of the fellowship and thus effectively the total period of fellowship will remain the same.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: Are The Candidates Who Have Qualified UGC-CSIR Also Eligible To Apply?
answer: Candidates who have qualified in NET-JRF or the UGC-CSIR joint tests.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: When Does The Student Have To Submit The Half-Yearly Progress Report?
answer: The student has to submit half yearly progress report after every six months to the Academic office, for sending to the UGC for release of fellowship in continuation.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
question: How Would The Candidate Transition From JRF To SRF?
answer: After completion of two years of the program, the student has to submit Three member Assessment committee report for upgradation from JRF to SRF to the Academic office for uploading on the UGC portal.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Are The Objectives Of This Scheme?
answer: The objective of this scheme is to provide an opportunity to research scholars to undertake advanced study and research in engineering and technology, and agricultural engineering, leading to Ph.D. Subjects like geology and geo-physics are not considered under this scheme.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is There A Validity To The Scheme Benefits?
answer: The benefits are provided till the complete duration of the course.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Is The Amount Of Fellowship Provided In This Scheme?
answer: Fellowship @ Rs. 14,000/- p.m. for the initial two years, @ Rs.15,000/- for the remaining period.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Is The Amount Of Contingency Provided In This Scheme?
answer: Contingency @ Rs.12,000/- p.a. for the initial two years, @Rs.25,000/- p.a. for the remaining period.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Is The Amount Of Departmental Assistance Provided In This Scheme?
answer: Departmental Assistance @ Rs. 3,000/- p.a. per student to the host institute for providing, infrastructure to the researcher.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Is The Amount Of Escorts/Reader Assistance Provided In This Scheme?
answer: Escorts/Reader Assistance @Rs.2,000/- p.m. in cases of physically handicapped and blind candidates.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is Medical Assistance Provided To The Candidate?
answer: Medical: No separate/fixed medical assistance is provided. However, the fellow may avail the medical facilities available in the institution/university.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: How Many Days Of Leave In A Year Are The Researchers Entitled To?
answer: Research Fellows are entitled to a maximum period of 30 days leave in a year in addition to public holidays.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is The Candidate Entitled To Leave, For Summer, Winter, Pooja Vacations?
answer: They are not entitled to any other leave, for example, summer, winter, pooja vacations, etc.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is Maternity Leave Provided To Women Candidates?
answer: Women candidates are eligible for maternity leave of 135 days at full rates of fellowship once during the tenure of their award.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Will The Period Of Leave Without Fellowship Be Counted Towards The Total Tenure Of The Fellowship?
answer: No, the period of leave without fellowship will be counted towards the total tenure of the fellowship.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: What Is The Total Period Of Fellowship (JRF And SRF)?
answer: The total period of fellowship (JRF and SRF) is five years, which is non-extendable. The awardee can avail research fellowship for the full tenure of the fellowship or up to the date of award of the Ph.D. degree, whichever is earlier.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is GATE Score Card Required For Getting A Research Fellowship To Pursue Ph.D.?
answer: GATE is not a mandatory condition for getting a research fellowship to pursue Ph.D.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is There An Age Criteria To This Scheme?
answer: Yes, the age limit is 40 years as on 1 July of the year of the award, extendable by five years for women and SC/ST candidates.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is There A Percent Of Fellowships That Are Reserved For SC/ST Candidates?
answer: A total of 22.5 percent of the fellowships are reserved for candidates belonging to SC/ST who fulfill the requisite qualifications laid down for the award. In case of the non-availability of SC/ST candidates, these slots will be made available to general candidates.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is There A Validity To The Scheme Benefits?
answer: The benefits are provided till the complete duration of the course.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Is There Any Application Fee?
answer: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
question: Do I Need To Complete The Application In One Sitting?
answer: No. You can save the application as draft and continue at a later time before the deadline.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What is the JRMB Scheme?
answer: It establishes local “banks” in jute clusters to supply raw jute material to JRCPC beneficiaries, WSHGs, artisans, and JDP micro/small units at mill-gate rates for cost-effective manufacturing.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: Who can run a JRMB?
answer: Bonafide Indian agencies—such as jute entrepreneurs, manufacturers, exporters, traders, NGOs, co-ops, or PSUs—with at least 3 years of relevant experience are eligible.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What financial support does NJB provide?
answer: NJB covers 30% of annual sales (capped at ₹12 lakh), including a 5% cash discount for beneficiaries and up to 25% for transportation costs.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: Is there extra support for hilly regions?
answer: Yes—an additional ₹1.50/kg freight reimbursement is given to JRMBs in hill areas like J&K, HP, Uttarakhand, NER states, Andaman, Lakshadweep.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What are the targets per JRMB?
answer: Each bank must achieve ₹40 lakh sales annually, serve at least 20 beneficiaries per year, and limit purchases to ₹2 lakh per beneficiary annually.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: How and when is the financial support disbursed?
answer: Claims are processed quarterly after submission of audited accounts, GST returns, bills/invoices, bank statements, and ledgers.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What infrastructure must the agency provide?
answer: The collaborating agency bears costs for warehouse, electricity, water, furniture, and office setup (min. 200 sq.ft), phone/internet, computer.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What raw materials can JRMBs supply?
answer: They may stock jute fibre, finer yarns, blended fabrics, laminated/technical textiles, decorative/ braided yarns—procured against GST invoices from registered mills.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: How should proposals be submitted?
answer: Applications must be submitted offline in sealed hard copy, signed on every page, with documents numbered sequentially.

scheme_name: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
question: What documents are required to apply?
answer: Include MoU/AoA/trade license, Aadhaar/address proof, PAN & ITRs (last FY), GST returns (last 3 FYs), audited statements (last 3 FYs), experience certificates, and local authority recommendations.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Who implements the scheme?
answer: The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Who can receive the award?
answer: Any individual who saves a life by demonstrating courage and promptness can receive the award.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Can armed forces personnel apply?
answer: Yes, personnel from armed forces are eligible to be nominated for the award.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Are civilians eligible?
answer: Yes, civilians are fully eligible to be considered for the award.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Can the award be given posthumously?
answer: Yes, the award can be conferred posthumously in deserving cases.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: How many categories are there?
answer: There are three categories of awards under the scheme.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: Is self-nomination allowed?
answer: No, self-nomination is not allowed and only authorized recommendations are accepted.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: What is required in the citation?
answer: A detailed citation of up to 250 words describing the life-saving act is required.

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
question: How are applications submitted?

scheme_name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards

answer: The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount, if any, shall be refunded to the Government within the stipulated timeframe as specified in the guidelines.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
question: Through which mode will the financial assistance amount be transferred to the beneficiary's account once the application is approved by the authorities?
answer: The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode directly to the bank account.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
question: Where should I submit my application form and all the required documents to apply for this self employment financial assistance?
answer: The application must be submitted directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days at the office of the department.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
question: Is there any certificate required to prove that I am not currently employed or engaged in any self employment activity?
answer: Yes, a certificate to the effect that the applicant is not employed or is not self employed from any Gazetted Officer must be enclosed to the application.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: What is the maximum allowable annual family income from all sources to be eligible for this specific financial grant?
answer: Only those families whose total annual family income from all sources is less than ₹25,000/- per annum shall be eligible for this grant category.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: If the primary eligible family member is not alive, who is eligible to receive the benefit instead?
answer: If the wife or husband predeceases the late artist, the benefit can be passed on to the unmarried or unemployed sons or daughters of the deceased artist.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: When the financial assistance is distributed among multiple secondary eligible family members, how is the grant apportioned?
answer: The benefit shall be passed on to the eligible unmarried or unemployed sons or daughters of the deceased artist in equal ratio.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Is there a specific official requirement regarding the status or recognition of the deceased Goan artist?
answer: The deceased artist must have been an aged and needy Goan Artist recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: How should the applicant prove their relationship to the deceased artist to substantiate their claim as an eligible family member?
answer: Applicants must enclose a marriage certificate or any other valid document indicating they are the eligible family member.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: What specific method is utilized by the Director of Art & Culture for disbursing the approved financial assistance amount?
answer: The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: What is the maximum financial amount that the family can receive as a lumpsum grant upon the unfortunate death of the artist?
answer: The maximum financial assistance provided in the form of a lumpsum grant upon the death of the artist is ₹20,000/-.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Where must the eligible artist's family submit the prescribed proforma application for this financial grant?
answer: The application must be submitted directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Who is prioritized as the primary family member to be considered for receiving the lumpsum financial assistance?
answer: The wife or husband of the late artist shall be considered first when applying for the grant amount.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Are there any additional certificates related to relationships or birth that might be required depending on the applicant?
answer: Yes, relevant documentation like dependency certificates or birth certificates may have to be enclosed as required under various objectives of the scheme.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Which essential official record must be enclosed with the application to confirm the loss of the eligible artist?
answer: The applicant must enclose a Death certificate of the late artist along with the application.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: When is the prescribed application proforma generally available for collection at the department office?
answer: The application forms will be available at the office of the department during the working days.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Which official document is necessary to verify that the family's annual income meets the maximum limit prescribed for this category?
answer: A necessary income certificate must be produced from the competent authority proving the annual family income is less than ₹25,000/- per annum.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
question: Does the deceased artist need to meet specific criteria related to their place of birth and upbringing in the state?
answer: Yes, the eligible artist must have been a Goan, meaning they were born and brought up in the State of Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: What is the maximum amount of financial support provided for marriages under this assistance program for artists' families?
answer: The financial assistance provided is ₹20,000/- for the first wholly dependent daughter's marriage and ₹15,000/- for the second daughter's marriage.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: If my annual family earnings from all sources are ₹2,50,000/-, would I still qualify for the marriage benefit?
answer: No, you would not qualify as the annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum to be eligible.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Can I receive assistance for the marriages of three daughters if all of them are wholly dependent on me?
answer: No, the scheme provides assistance for a maximum of two wholly dependent unmarried daughters only.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: What happens to the financial assistance amount that remains unused after my daughter's wedding expenses are completed?
answer: The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount must be refunded to the Government within 2 months from the date of marriage.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Is there any specific age requirement that I need to meet as an artist to apply for this marriage assistance?
answer: Yes, the age limit for grant of benefits shall be not less than 50 years in case of the eligible artist, though the Government may relax this in deserving cases.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: What type of certificate do I need to provide to establish that my daughter is wholly dependent on me?
answer: You must submit a dependency certificate from the authorized authority to establish that your daughter is wholly dependent on you.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: After receiving the marriage assistance amount, what documentation am I required to submit to the department?
answer: You must furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department after the completion of the marriage.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Can I apply for this assistance if my daughter is already married or if the wedding ceremony has already taken place?
answer: The scheme is meant for wholly dependent unmarried daughters, so they must be unmarried at the time of application for eligibility.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Do I need to have formal recognition from any government body to be considered eligible for this marriage assistance?
answer: Yes, you must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa to be eligible for this assistance.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Where exactly should I go to obtain and submit the application form for this marriage assistance program?
answer: You should visit the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days to obtain and submit the application form.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: What is the consequence if I fail to attach all the required certificates and documents with my application?
answer: If all relevant documentation like birth certificate, marriage certificate, dependency certificates, and income certificates are not enclosed, the application shall be summarily rejected.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: If I am born in Goa but currently reside outside the state, can I still apply for this assistance?
answer: The applicant must be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Through what method will the approved financial assistance amount be transferred to my account?
answer: The Director of Art & Culture shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant through Electronic Clearing System mode.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
question: Who has the final authority to resolve any disputes or grievances that may arise during the implementation of this scheme?
answer: The Minister for Art & Culture shall hear and decide such matters, and the decision of the Minister for Art & Culture shall be final.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: What is the maximum financial assistance I can receive for my medical treatment expenses under this component?
answer: The maximum financial assistance available is ₹50,000/-. However, the Government may relax this ceiling in case of major chronic ailments requiring higher expenditure.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: If I need emergency treatment and cannot get an estimate beforehand, will my application still be considered valid?
answer: Yes, your application will be considered valid. In case of treatment availed or to be availed on emergency basis, the estimate from the authorized doctor or hospital can be submitted subsequently.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Can I apply for financial assistance to cover the medical treatment costs of my wholly dependent family members?
answer: Yes, financial assistance is provided to meet expenses towards treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members, including travelling and accommodation expenses outside the state.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: What is the minimum age requirement that I must fulfill to be eligible for applying for financial assistance?
answer: The age limit for grant of benefits is not less than 50 years. However, the Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: After I receive the financial assistance and complete my treatment, what documentation do I need to submit to the department?
answer: You must furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department within 3 months from completion of the treatment.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: What should I do with any remaining amount if I do not utilize the entire sanctioned financial assistance for my treatment?
answer: Any unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount must be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Can I claim reimbursement from another government department if I have already received financial assistance for the same medical treatment?
answer: No, you cannot avail the benefit of medical reimbursement from any other Government department or under any schemes or policies for the medical treatment for which financial assistance is granted.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: What is the annual family income limit that I must not exceed to qualify for this financial assistance?
answer: Your annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum to be eligible for the financial assistance under this component.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Where can I obtain and submit the application form for seeking financial assistance for medical treatment expenses?
answer: You can obtain and submit the prescribed application form directly at the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Does the financial assistance cover expenses for treatment only in local hospitals or can I seek treatment outside the state?
answer: The financial assistance covers major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals, and also includes expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: What type of recognition from authorities do I need to have to be considered eligible for this financial assistance?
answer: You must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa, and you should be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: How will the approved financial assistance amount be transferred to me after the government approval is obtained for my application?
answer: After obtaining Government approval, the Director of Art & Culture shall disburse the one time financial assistance amount in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to your bank account.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Besides the medical estimate, what other certificates and documents must I attach with my application to substantiate my eligibility?
answer: You must attach birth certificate, marriage certificate (if applicable), dependency certificate (for family members), income certificate, medical certificate, and recognition certificate from the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
question: Who can apply on my behalf if I am unable to submit the application myself for the financial assistance?
answer: Eligible artist or the family or co-artist or any member of the public can apply in prescribed proforma directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture on your behalf.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: What is the minimum age requirement for an artist to be eligible for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision?
answer: The applicant must be above 18 years of age and must have lost their source of income due to the COVID-19 pandemic to qualify for this assistance.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: If I am working on a contract or daily wage basis in a private organization, can I still apply for this financial support?
answer: Yes, employees working on contract or daily wages are considered eligible, provided their individual annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: What is the maximum annual income limit from all sources that makes an artist eligible for pandemic-related financial assistance?
answer: The individual annual income of the artist from all sources must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum to be eligible for this pandemic relief.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Are artists who are currently receiving monthly pensions under the Kala Samman scheme eligible to apply for this assistance?
answer: No, beneficiaries of Kala Samman who receive monthly pensions from the Department of Art & Culture are not eligible for this scheme.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: What is the range of lumpsum financial assistance that an eligible artist can receive under the pandemic relief category?
answer: The financial assistance ranges from a minimum of ₹5,000/- to a maximum of ₹10,000/- as a lumpsum amount per eligible artist.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Can a government employee or a pensioner from any organization apply for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision?
answer: No, the applicant must not be a government employee, an employee of autonomous bodies or corporations, or a pensioner from any organization.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Is it mandatory for the applicant to be solely dependent on art-related activities and programmes to qualify for assistance?
answer: Yes, the applicant must be solely dependent on art-related activities and programmes to be considered eligible for this financial assistance.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Can an artist working on a regular payroll basis in a private company or institution apply for this scheme?
answer: No, the applicant must not be working in any private agency, company, or institution on a regular basis or be on a regular payroll.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: What fields of art and culture are recognized for eligibility under the pandemic relief component of this scheme?
answer: Artists working in Music, Dance, Drama, Tiatr, Folk, Kirtan, Bhajan, Painting, Sculpture, Literature, Cantarists, Sahittik, Poets, Photographers, and traditional Handicraft are eligible.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Is there any requirement to submit a declaration or affidavit regarding income from all sources when applying for assistance?
answer: Yes, applicants must submit a self-signed affidavit or declaration on ₹50/- stamp paper in the prescribed format regarding their individual income from all sources per annum.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: Are artists who are receiving any other pension or financial assistance from the Central or State Government eligible for this scheme?
answer: No, artists receiving any other pension or financial assistance from either the Central Government or State Government are not eligible for this scheme.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: What is the residency requirement for artists applying for pandemic-related financial assistance under this scheme?
answer: The applicant artist must be a resident of Goa to be eligible for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: How does the committee determine the exact quantum of financial assistance to be sanctioned to each eligible artist?
answer: The committee will decide the quantum of assistance to be sanctioned within the prescribed limit of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- based on their assessment.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
question: In what mode will the financial assistance amount be disbursed to the eligible artist under the pandemic relief category?
answer: The financial assistance will be released directly into the bank account of the artist opened in a nationalized bank through Electronic Clearing System mode.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: What is the monthly scholarship amount that will be provided to eligible students under this financial assistance program?
answer: Eligible wards receive a monthly scholarship of ₹750/- during the academic year, excluding vacation periods. The scholarship is disbursed on a half-yearly basis to support their educational expenses.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Is there any specific requirement regarding the type of educational courses for which the scholarship can be availed?
answer: Yes, the ward must be enrolled in Post Graduate, Degree, or Professional courses at recognized educational institutions. These courses can be pursued either within the State of Goa or outside the state.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: What is the minimum age criterion that must be satisfied by the parent or guardian who is an artist applying for this benefit?
answer: The parent or guardian artist must be at least 50 years of age at the time of application. However, the Government may relax this age criterion for deserving cases under special circumstances.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Are there any income limitations that need to be considered when applying for this educational financial support?
answer: Yes, the annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. An income certificate from the competent authority must be submitted along with the application.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Is there any restriction on the location or state where the ward can pursue their higher education?
answer: No, there is no geographical restriction. The ward can be enrolled in recognized educational institutions either within the State of Goa or outside the state for pursuing eligible courses.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Will the scholarship be provided during the vacation periods or breaks in the academic calendar?
answer: No, the scholarship of ₹750/- per month is provided only during the currency of the academic year. The vacation period is explicitly excluded from the scholarship disbursement.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: What is the frequency or periodicity with which the scholarship amount will be transferred to the beneficiary?
answer: The scholarship amount is disbursed on a half-yearly basis. This means payments are made twice during the academic year to cover the eligible period.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Is it mandatory for the parent or guardian artist to have official recognition from any specific government department?
answer: Yes, the parent or guardian artist must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The recognition certificate must be submitted along with the application.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Where should the completed application form along with all supporting documents be submitted physically?
answer: The completed application form with all required documents should be submitted directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working hours on any working day.

scheme_name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
question: Through which mode will the scholarship amount be transferred to the beneficiary after approval?
answer: After obtaining Government approval, the Director of Art & Culture disburses the scholarship amount through Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account provided during the application process.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: What is the main objective of this scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to provide safe, timely, and free transport for pregnant women and newborn babies (0–1 year) to and from hospitals.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: Who can benefit from this scheme?
answer: Pregnant women and newborn babies up to 1 year of age can avail benefits under this scheme.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: Is there any age limit for newborn babies under this scheme?
answer: Yes, the scheme covers newborn babies from 0 to 1 year of age.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: How can beneficiaries access this service?
answer: The service can be availed free of cost by calling 102.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: Does the scheme provide transportation for ultrasound visits?
answer: Yes, pregnant women get free to-and-fro transport from home to hospital for ultrasound services.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: How many vehicles are available for this service in the state?
answer: A total of 128 vehicles are deployed across Uttarakhand for providing these services.

scheme_name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
question: Are there any charges for using this service?
answer: No, the service is completely free of cost.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana

answer: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided to the farmers by the Rajasthan government for fencing their fields.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: How much amount is available under Tarbandi Scheme Rajasthan?
answer: Under the scheme, 50% subsidy is given by the Rajasthan Government and a maximum amount of [?]40,000/- is given by the government.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: May Other State persons also apply for this scheme?
answer: No, only Rajasthan people can apply for this scheme.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: What Is The Financial Eligibility For Applicant ?

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: Who Can Get The Benefits Of The Scheme ?
answer: Farmers can get the benefits of this scheme.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: How much individual and farmer group the Land Holding Eligibility ?
answer: In case of individual and farmer group, the applicant must have minimum 1.5 hectare land at one place.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: What is DBT?
answer: Direct Benefit Transfer is a system of transferring money from the government to the beneficiary's bank account.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: Is this scheme for Urban area?
answer: Yes, Urban and Rural both can apply for this scheme.

scheme_name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
question: What is the limit of fencing per farmer ?
answer: It will be up to 400 meters of fencing per farmer.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: What is the objective of the scheme?
answer: The Kisan Kaleva Yojana is a scheme introduced by the Rajasthan Government to provide subsidized meals to farmers and their assistants at vegetable market premises.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: Who is eligible to benefit from the Kisan Kaleva Yojana?
answer: Farmers and their assistants who come to sell crops at vegetable market premises are eligible to benefit from this scheme.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: How does the scheme work?
answer: The scheme offers food at concessional rates through coupons, allowing registered farmers and their assistants to avail a plate of food for a nominal price.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: What is the maximum price for food under the Kisan Kaleva Yojana?
answer: The maximum price for food is fixed at [?] 40, with [?]35 subsidized by the market committee and [?] 5 contributed by the farmer and laborer.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: Will farmers get different types of food in winter and summer?
answer: Yes, vegetables and jaggery will be available as per season.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: How long will the food coupon be valid?
answer: The food coupon will be valid for 24 hours.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: How has the Kisan Kaleva Yojana benefited agricultural communities in Rajasthan?
answer: The scheme has provided significant relief to farmers and their assistants by reducing their expenses on meals and ensuring they have access to essential food items during their work hours.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: Any education qualification required for the scheme?
answer: There is no qualification requirement for this scheme.

scheme_name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
question: Is there any criteria related to caste in this scheme?
answer: No, there are no cast criteria in this scheme.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: What is the primary objective of the "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)"?
answer: The primary objective of the "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)" is to improve the basic and modern infrastructure facilities in Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) across Gujarat to enhance agricultural marketing efficiency and benefit both producers and consumers.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: Who is eligible to receive benefits under this scheme?
answer: Only the Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) functioning within the jurisdiction of the state of Gujarat are eligible to receive financial assistance under the "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)".

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: What types of infrastructure can be developed under this scheme?
answer: Under the scheme, APMCs can utilize financial assistance for developing infrastructure such as auction sheds, parking sheds, compound walls, roads, weigh-bridges, cold storage units, ripening chambers, and facilities for cleaning, grading, and sanitation.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: Does the scheme provide support for farmer training and awareness programs?
answer: Yes, the scheme also includes assistance for establishing farmers' training centers and organizing awareness camps to educate farmers about improved agricultural practices including appropriate use of seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: Are there any specific allocations based on the classification of APMCs?
answer: The scheme allocates 25% of the total funds to Class 'A' and 'B' APMCs, while 50% of the allocation is reserved for Class 'C' and 'D' APMCs, thereby giving priority to markets with lower classifications to support their development.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: Can individual farmers apply for assistance under this scheme?
answer: No, individual farmers are not eligible to apply directly for this scheme, as it is exclusively designed to support registered APMCs in the state for improving public market infrastructure and facilities.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: What role do farmer-consumer markets play under this scheme?
answer: The scheme encourages the development of farmer-consumer markets by providing necessary facilities that enable farmers to sell their produce directly to consumers, reducing dependency on middlemen and ensuring fair prices for both parties.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: Is support available for sanitation and waste management under this scheme?
answer: Yes, APMCs can receive financial support under this scheme for procuring solid waste management equipment and improving sanitation facilities within market premises to maintain hygiene and ensure safe handling of agricultural produce.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: What type of application form is required to apply for the scheme?
answer: The applicant APMC is required to submit a proposal on plain paper without any application fee, and the form must be obtained from and submitted to the respective District Registrar of Co-operative Societies.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
question: What kind of outcomes does the scheme aim to achieve in the agricultural marketing system?
answer: The scheme aims to create a more efficient, modern, and farmer-friendly agricultural marketing system by equipping APMCs with updated infrastructure, promoting direct marketing, ensuring proper sanitation, and empowering farmers through training and awareness initiatives.

scheme_name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)

answer: The applicant can apply at the local District Fisheries Office or the Antyodaya SARAL portal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
question: Can I buy any model of motorcycle?
answer: Yes, but it must be equipped with an ice box suitable for fish transport.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: What is the objective of the "Mukhyamantri Chhatravritti Yojana"?
answer: The objective of the "Mukhyamantri Chhatravritti Yojana" is to provide financial support to deserving NCC cadets so that they can continue their education and remain motivated to actively participate in NCC training and activities.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Who is eligible to apply for the "Mukhyamantri Chhatravritti Yojana"?
answer: Students who are enrolled as NCC cadets and have successfully passed either Class 10 or Class 12 in the previous academic session, and who are currently pursuing higher education, are eligible to apply under this scholarship scheme.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Is the scholarship available to both Junior Division and Senior Division NCC cadets?
answer: Yes, the scheme is available to cadets in both the Junior Division/Junior Wing and the Senior Division/Senior Wing categories who meet the required eligibility criteria.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: What is the scholarship amount provided under the "Mukhyamantri Chhatravritti Yojana"?
answer: Under the scheme, a scholarship amount of ₹2,400/- is awarded to 3 senior cadets at the group level, ₹1,200/- to 3 junior cadets at the group level, ₹1,200/- to 18 senior cadets at the unit level, and ₹600/- to 16 junior cadets at the unit level.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: What are the training requirements for applicants of this scheme?
answer: To be considered eligible, the applicant must have undergone a minimum of two years of NCC training and must have maintained at least 80% attendance in NCC parades during each year of training.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Are cadets receiving other government scholarships eligible for this scheme?
answer: No, cadets who are already receiving any special scholarships from the government, other than the regular state scholarships for general students, are not eligible to apply under this scheme.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Is there any limitation on the number of cadets selected from each group or unit?
answer: Yes, from each group, only 3 senior and 3 junior cadets are selected, and from each unit, 18 senior and 16 junior cadets are selected based on merit and eligibility.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Is it mandatory for cadets to continue their education to receive this scholarship?
answer: Yes, only those cadets who are currently pursuing higher education are eligible, as continuing education is a mandatory criterion for receiving this scholarship.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: Can applications for the "Mukhyamantri Chhatravritti Yojana" be submitted online?
answer: No, the application process for this scheme is entirely offline, and the applications are collected through designated Group Headquarters or Units in schools and colleges where NCC is active.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
question: How are cadets selected for the scholarship under this scheme?
answer: A Board of Officers constituted by the Group Headquarters evaluates and verifies the application forms and supporting documents, and forwards the recommended applications to the Directorate for final approval and disbursement.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: Which communities are eligible?

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)

answer: Dindori, Umaria, Shahdol, Anuppur, Mandla, Balaghat, Chhindwara, Gwalior, Datia, Shivpuri, Guna, Ashoknagar, Sheopurkala, Morena, and Bhind.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: What animals are provided under this scheme?
answer: High-yielding dairy cows or Murrah buffaloes, calves under 2 months of age.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: What is the subsidy provided?
answer: 90% subsidy; the beneficiary pays 10% of the cost.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: Is training provided to beneficiaries?
answer: Yes, all beneficiaries receive pre-distribution training in dairy management.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: How are beneficiaries selected?
answer: Beneficiaries are selected through a multi-level approval process, starting with the Gram Sabha, followed by the Janpad Panchayat, and finally the District Panchayat Agricultural Committee.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: Can non-tribal farmers apply?
answer: No, only eligible tribal communities can participate.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: How many animals does each beneficiary receive?
answer: Two dairy animals (cow or Murrah buffalo).

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: Who monitors the distribution and animal quality?
answer: Deputy Director of Veterinary Services and Madhya Pradesh State Livestock and Poultry Development Corporation.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
question: Where to apply for the scheme?
answer: At the nearest Veterinary Officer, Veterinary Dispensary In-Charge, or Deputy Director of Veterinary Services in the designated districts.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: What is the objective of the "Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat" scheme?
answer: The scheme "Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat, aims to offer reimbursement for stall rent, product literature, and display materials to MSMEs participating in exhibitions at state, national, and international levels.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: Who is eligible to apply for assistance under this scheme?
answer: Industry associations, federations of industries associations, and chambers of commerce that organize industrial exhibitions in the interest of the manufacturing sector are eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: What percentage of the electricity bill is reimbursed under the scheme?
answer: The scheme provides reimbursement of 60% of the electricity bill incurred during the exhibition period, including the pre-preparation period.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: Is prior approval from the MSME Commissioner required to avail of the benefit?
answer: Yes, obtaining prior approval from the MSME Commissioner is mandatory to qualify for assistance under the scheme.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: What type of exhibitions qualify for assistance under this scheme?
answer: Only industrial exhibitions that focus on the manufacturing sector and receive prior approval from the MSME Commissioner are eligible for assistance.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: Can individual businesses or private firms apply for this assistance?
answer: No, the scheme is only available to recognized industry associations, federations of industries associations, and chambers of commerce.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: Will exhibitions held outside the policy period be eligible for assistance?
answer: No, only exhibitions organized within the specified policy period will qualify for reimbursement.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: How is the assistance provided to eligible organizers?
answer: The assistance is provided as a reimbursement based on the actual electricity expenditure incurred during the exhibition period.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: What happens if an exhibition is organized without obtaining prior approval?
answer: Exhibitions organized without prior approval from the MSME Commissioner will not be eligible for reimbursement under the scheme.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
question: Is there a maximum limit on the amount that can be reimbursed?
answer: The reimbursement is strictly limited to 60% of the actual electricity expenditure incurred during the exhibition and pre-preparation period.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What is the objective of the "Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)" scheme?
answer: The scheme "Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat, aims to offer reimbursement for stall rent, product literature, and display materials to MSMEs participating in exhibitions at state, national, and international levels.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
answer: Any MSME enterprise engaged in manufacturing, registered in Gujarat, and participating in approved exhibitions or trade fairs is eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What types of exhibitions qualify for financial assistance?
answer: The scheme covers State, National, and International level exhibitions organized by industry associations, federations, chambers of commerce, the State Government (or its agencies), and recognized international organizations.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: Is participation in international exhibitions outside India eligible for assistance?
answer: Yes, MSMEs participating in international exhibitions outside India are eligible for 60% assistance up to [?]5,00,000/-, provided the exhibition is approved by recognized bodies like ITPO, EEPC, FIEO, or the Ministry of MSME.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: How many times can an MSME avail the benefits of this scheme?
answer: An MSME can participate a maximum of 5 times in State, National, and International (Inside India) exhibitions combined. | An MSME can participate a maximum of 3 times in International (Outside India) exhibitions during the scheme's operative period.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What expenses are covered under the scheme?
answer: The scheme provides reimbursement for stall rent, product literature, and display material costs.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What is the application process for claiming assistance?
answer: The MSME must apply through the IFP Portal of the District Industries Centre (DIC) within six months from the last date of the exhibition. The required documents must be uploaded for verification.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: Can an MSME avail benefits under both State and Central Government schemes?
answer: Yes, an MSME may avail benefits under both schemes, but not for the same components. The total assistance from both sources cannot exceed the actual expenditure.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What happens if an MSME applies after six months of exhibition participation?
answer: If an MSME submits the application after six months, the request for reimbursement will not be considered.

scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
question: What if an MSME receives assistance from another Gujarat Government scheme for the same exhibition?
answer: If an MSME has already received financial support under another Gujarat Government scheme for the same purpose, it will not be eligible for this scheme unless explicitly mentioned otherwise.

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

answer: Approved Tourism Service Providers and State Governments/UT Administrations can apply.

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme
question: What types of activities are covered under the scheme?
answer: Sales tours, participation in travel fairs/exhibitions, online promotion, and digital content production are covered.

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme
question: How many tours can a TSP undertake in a year under the scheme?

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme
question: How to claim reimbursement?

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: What documents must be submitted along with the entry form for participation?
answer: A photocopy of the renewed registration certificate must be submitted within the stipulated period along with the prescribed entry form.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group

answer: Yes, there is an entry fee of ₹500/- and a refundable security deposit of ₹5,000/-.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: How are participating institutions selected for this competition?
answer: Entries are invited through press notes in local newspapers, and eligible institutions must submit required documents within the given timeframe.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: What financial assistance is provided for transporting artistes and stage materials?
answer: Transport charges for two vehicles, as per government rates and Kala Academy norms, are provided for to-and-fro travel.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Is any auditorium facility provided free of cost for the competition?

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Are participating institutions entitled to any share from ticket sales?

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Are there any consolation prizes, and under what conditions are they awarded?

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: What are the prize amounts for best direction in both competition groups?

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: How much are the prizes for best male actor in Group A and Group B?
answer: In Group A, 1st prize is ₹7,000/- and 2nd prize ₹5,000/-. In Group B, 1st prize is ₹5,000/- and 2nd prize ₹3,000/-.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: What are the prize amounts for best female actor in both competition groups?
answer: In Group A, 1st prize is ₹7,000/- and 2nd prize ₹5,000/-. In Group B, 1st prize is ₹5,000/- and 2nd prize ₹3,000/-.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Are there any awards for stage design and setting, and how much are they?
answer: Yes, stage design/setting awards are ₹5,000/- for Group A and ₹4,000/- for Group B.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Is there a prize for best lighting in the competition?
answer: Yes, the prize for lighting is ₹5,000/- in Group A and ₹4,000/- in Group B.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Are costumes considered for awards, and what are the prize amounts?
answer: Yes, best costume awards are ₹5,000/- for Group A and ₹4,000/- for Group B.

scheme_name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
question: Is background music judged separately, and what are the prize amounts?
answer: Yes, background music awards are ₹5,000/- for Group A and ₹4,000/- for Group B.

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
question: What is the objective of the scheme?

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
question: What is the pattern of assistance?

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
question: How to avail the benefits of the scheme?

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme

scheme_name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
