question: Can I apply for an internship opportunity if I am enrolled in an online/distance/ correspondence course?
answer: Yes, Candidates enrolled in online/ distance/correspondence learning programmes are eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Internship Scheme
question: I am ineligible to apply because of my age. Can you please relax the age criteria?
answer: As of now, the age criteria for the Prime Minister Internship Scheme are 21-24 years. If there is any relaxation in the age criteria in the future, we will communicate the same on the portal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Can I Open A Joint Account Under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana?
answer: Yes. You can open a joint account under Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Where Do I Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
answer: You can open a PMJDY account at any bank branch on Core Banking Solutions (CBS) or at a BC outlet of such Banks.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Can I Link My Mobile Number With My Bank Account Opened Under PMJDY?
answer: Yes. You can link your mobile number with your bank account. You can do so by contacting your bank where you have opened your bank account under PMJDY. Bank will enter your mobile number in the CBS system based on the information provided by you.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Is A Small Account or Chota Khata under PMJDY ?
answer: A "Small Account" or "Chota Account" can be opened in case of non availability of Officially Valid Documents (OVDs). These accounts would be valid normally for a period of twelve months. Thereafter, such accounts would be allowed to a continue for a further period of twelve more months, if the account-holder provides a document showing that he/she has applied for any of the Officially Valid Document, within 12 months of opening the small account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Does The PMJDY Scheme Offer Accidental Insurance Cover ?
answer: All PMJDY Accounts are provided with a free Rupay Debit Card with inbuilt accidental insurance cover of Rs.2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Is Overdraft/Loan Facility Available Under PMJDY?
answer: Overdraft facility (SBOD) upto Rs. 10,000/- will be available to one account holder of PMJDY per household after 6 months of satisfactory conduct of the account, subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Is It Possible To Extend My Loan Amount Taken Against My PMJDY Bank Account?
answer: Yes, it is possible to extend your loan/overdraft taken against your PMJDY Bank Account. Bank may increase this amount, provided you make your repayments on time subject to a maximum amount of Rs. 10,000/-.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: How Much Processing Fees Do I Need To Pay For Processing The Loan Against My Account?
answer: There is no processing fees.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What About Mobile Banking Facility? Does My Account Opened Under The PMJDY Scheme Provide Mobile Banking?
answer: Yes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Is A Minor Eligible To Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
answer: Yes. A minor is eligible to open a bank account under PMJDY under guardianship.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Are Minors Eligible To Receive RuPay Cards Offered Under PMJDY Bank Accounts?
answer: Yes. Minors are eligible to get RuPay Cards. They can use the card 4 times in a month for cash withdrawal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Are The Documents Required For Opening A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
answer: The following documents are required - | - AADHAAR | - Government ID proofs (Voter Card/PAN Card/Ration card) | - Permanent Address proof (Passport/Driving License/Electricity Bill/Telephone Bill/Water Bill) | - Passport size photograph | - Filled and Signed PMJDY Account opening form | - Any other document as notified by the Central Government in consultation with the Regulator.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What If I Don't' Have A Valid Residential Proof? Will I Be Able To Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
answer: Yes. You can still open a bank account. What you have to do is to provide an identity proof issued by the Government of India.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Can A RuPay Card Be Availed By Illiterate Account Holders?
answer: Yes. It can be availed by illiterate account holders as well. RuPay Card is a kind of debit card issued for the purpose of ATM withdrawal and making PoS payments. The concerned bank officials will educate the illiterate RuPay Card holders as to how to use this card and keep it safe at the time of card issuance.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Will I Get A Cheque Book Against My Bank Account?
answer: The accounts can be opened under PMJDY with Zero balance. Cheque book(s) are not a mandatory feature of PMJDY A/cs. Banks can offer additional services including Cheque Books as per the norms specified by each Bank. One can avail the same by meeting the criteria.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: How Much Interest Do I Receive On My Savings Account Opened Under PMJDY?
answer: The applicable rate of interest is equal to interest on saving account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Do Banks Charge Account Opening Fees For Opening An Account Under PMJDY?
answer: Banks do not charge any fees while opening PMJDY account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Is The Bank Account Opened Under PMJDY Transferrable? What If I Want To Transfer My Account from One City To Another Or One State To Other?
answer: Yes. You can easily transfer your PMJDY account from one city/state to another as all banks offering bank accounts have core banking solutions (intra-bank). You can do this by simply requesting the bank.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Is a Bank Mitr?
answer: Bank Mitr is a Business Correspondent who provides banking services at select locations. The Bank Mitr represents the bank and helps it expand its outreach. He offers banking services at areas where establishing a brick and mortar branch is not feasible. Retired Bank Employees, Retired Teachers, Retired Government Employees and Ex-Servicemen can join as a Bank Mitr.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Minimum Balance Do I Need To Put In My Bank Account?
answer: There is no requirement of minimum balance .

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Is a PoS Machine?
answer: It is a small device installed at business centres to help you enjoy cashless purchases. PoS stands for Point of Sale.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: I Am An Existing PMJDY Customer Of A Particular Bank And I Want To Open Another Bank Account Under PMJDY, Am I Eligible?
answer: No. A person can have only one PMJDY Account . However, if he/she wants to open a Basic Saving Bank Account or a PMJDY Account in other bank, the existing Account will have to be closed within 30 days of opening an Account in the other bank.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What Is The Exit Age Determined By This Scheme?
answer: There is no exit age under this Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: What If I Don't Have Any Documents? How Will I Open An Account Then?
answer: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) vide its Press Release dated 26.08.2014 has clarified as under : | "Those persons who do not have any of the 'officially valid documents' can open "Small Accounts" with banks' branch". | A "Small Account" can be opened on the basis of a self-attested photograph and putting his/her signatures or thumb print in the presence of an official(s) of the bank. Such accounts have limitations regarding : | i. aggregate credits (not more than Rupees one lac in a year), | ii. aggregate withdrawals (not more than Rupees ten thousand in a month), and | iii. balance in the accounts (not more than Rupees fifty thousand at any point of time). | These accounts would be valid normally for a period of twelve months. Thereafter, such accounts would be allowed to a continue for a further period of twelve more months, if the account-holder provides a document showing that he/she has applied for any of the Officially Valid Document, within 12 months of opening the small account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
question: Can I Change My Address In The Bank Account?
answer: Yes. You can change your address by providing a self-declaration certificate or submitting supporting documents.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: How do I pay the premium for PMJJBY?
answer: The premium will be deducted from the account holder's bank / Post office account through 'auto debit' facility.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: What is the validity of the insurance cover in PMJJBY?
answer: Coverage under PMJJBY is valid for one year from 1st June to 31st May on payment of annual premium.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: Is delayed enrolment for prospective cover possible under this scheme?
answer: Yes. | Delayed enrolment for prospective cover is possible on payment of premium as described below - | a)	For enrolment in June, July and August - Full Annual Premium of Rs.436/- is payable. | b) For enrolment in September, October, and November -premium of Rs. 342/- is payable | c) For enrolment in December, January and February -premium of Rs. 228/- is payable. | d)	For enrolment in March, April and May -premium of Rs. 114/- is payable.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: If I decide to exit the scheme, is there any possibility that I can rejoin at a later point of time?
answer: Yes. | One can enroll again under the same conditions of eligibility stipulated in the Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: Who will offer / administer the scheme?
answer: The scheme would be offered / administered through Insurance companies willing to offer the product with necessary approvals on similar terms, in collaboration with participating Banks. Participating banks will be free to engage any such insurance company for implementing the scheme for their subscribers.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: What is the minimum eligibility to subscribe to PMJJBY?
answer: All savings bank account holders in the age 18 to 50 years in participating banks will be entitled to join. | In case of multiple bank accounts held by an individual in one or different banks, the person would be eligible to join the scheme through one saving bank account only.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: Who would be the Master policy holder for the scheme?
answer: Participating Banks/ Post Offices will be the Master policy holders.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: Are NRIs eligible for coverage under PMJJBY?
answer: Any NRI having an eligible bank account with a bank branch located in India is eligible for purchase of PMJJBY cover subject to fulfilment of the terms and conditions relating to the scheme. However, in case a claim arises, the claim benefit will be paid to the beneficiary/ nominee only in Indian currency.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: Does the PMJJBY cover death resulting from natural calamities such as earthquake, flood and other convulsions of nature? What about coverage from suicide / murder?
answer: Yes, all these events are covered under PMJJBY.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: What are the changes in the terms of insurance coverage applicable to new subscribers?
answer: For subscribers enrolling for the first time on or after 1st June 2016, insurance benefit shall not be available for death (due to any cause other than accident) occurring during the first 30 days from the date of enrolment into the scheme. Death due to accidental causes will be covered from day one of insurance coverage.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
question: How do I access the Claim Form for PMJJBY?
answer: The claim forms can be accessed from the link - https://www.jansuraksha.gov.in/Files/PMJJBY/English/ClaimForm.pdf

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
question: What is the Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)?
answer: PMJVK is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs that aims to develop infrastructure and provide basic amenities in Minority Concentrated Areas (MCAs). The scheme focuses on education, health, skill development, housing, and community assets to ensure inclusive growth of minority communities.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
question: Who can benefit from PMJVK?
answer: The benefits of PMJVK are area-based and cover all communities residing in Minority Concentrated Areas (MCAs). However, the focus is on improving living conditions for notified minority communities — Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
question: How are projects selected under PMJVK?
answer: Projects are proposed by State or UT Minority Welfare Departments and District Authorities based on local development needs through State Level Committees constituted at the State level. These proposals are examined by the Screening Committee and then put before the Empowered Committee at the Ministry of Minority Affairs to consideration and approval depending upon the criteria set in the guidelines of PMJVK scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
question: Can individuals directly apply for benefits under PMJVK?
answer: No, PMJVK is not an individual-benefit or cash-transfer scheme. It is implemented through State and District authorities to create community infrastructure and public amenities.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
question: What types of projects are funded under PMJVK?
answer: PMJVK supports construction of schools, hostels, health centres, community halls, colleges, hospitals, sports stadiums drinking water facilities, skill development centres, etc. in Minority Concentrated Areas.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What is "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PMKMY)"?
answer: PMKMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Government of India to provide old-age security to small and marginal farmers.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: Who is eligible to join PMKMY?
answer: Small and marginal farmers aged between 18 and 40 years with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares are eligible to enroll in the scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What pension benefit is provided under PMKMY?
answer: After attaining the age of 60 years, beneficiaries receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000/-.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: Who is eligible to join PMKMY?
answer: Small and marginal farmers aged between 18 and 40 years with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares are eligible to enroll in the scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What pension benefit is provided under PMKMY?
answer: After attaining the age of 60 years, beneficiaries receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000/-.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: How much contribution is required from farmers?
answer: The contribution depends on the age at entry and ranges from ₹55/- to ₹200/- per month.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: Does the Government contribute to the scheme?
answer: Yes, the Government of India makes an equal matching contribution to the farmer’s contribution.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What happens if the beneficiary dies during the scheme period?
answer: If the beneficiary dies before the pension age, the spouse can continue the scheme by paying the remaining contributions.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What happens if the beneficiary dies after starting pension?
answer: After the death of the pensioner, the spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension as a family pension.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: Can a beneficiary exit the scheme?
answer: Yes, beneficiaries can voluntarily exit the scheme before the age of 60 years under specified conditions.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
question: What happens if the beneficiary exits before 10 years?
answer: If the beneficiary exits before completing 10 years, only the farmer’s contribution along with savings bank interest will be returned.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Recognition Of Prior Learning

answer: RPL under PMKVY can be implemented via five modes: viz. RPL at Camps/Centers, RPL at Employer's Premise, RPL by Demand, RPL with Best-in-Class Employers and Online RPL. Process of implementation largely remains the same in all five modes. | RPL Type 1-Camps: This is proposed to be conducted for target beneficiaries in a location where workers of a sector are consolidated (such as industrial and/ or traditional skill clusters). This type can have a Bridge component. | RPL Type 2-Employer Premises: This type of RPL is conducted on site at the employer's premises for industrial employees. This type can have a Bridge component. | RPL Type 3A: RPL by Demand through District Skill Committee(DSC)s: Districts will mobilize candidates (200 per district in one job role) and certification will happen at designated PMKKs or PMKVY centres (if PMKK centres are not present or if the demand for the job role is different from those available in PMKK centres. | RPL Type 3B: RPL by Demand through Demand Aggregation Portal (DAP): RPL execution at designated Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) centers. Any individual can request for RPL at the available centre for a job role via DAP. | RPL Type 4-RPL with Best-in-Class Employers (BICE)-Large Corporations/industry and Medium Scale Enterprises: This type of RPL involves Best-in-Class Employers in both large and medium enterprises that are selected as per SSC criteria. Employees of best-in-class employers are certified by 'Employer- Assessor'. | RPL Type 5-Online RPL: This type of demand-based RPL is open to all skill seekers who wish to take an online exam and get certified. Proctoring is executed through video links and other tools without any physical interface.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: What Is PMMSY?
answer: The PMMSY is an umbrella scheme with two separate components namely | (a) Central Sector Scheme (CS) and (b) Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS). | The Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) Component is further segregated | into Non-beneficiary oriented and beneficiary orientated subcomponents/activities under the following three broad heads: | (i) Enhancement of Production and Productivity | (ii) Infrastructure and Post-Harvest Management | (iii) Fisheries Management and Regulatory Framework

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: What Is The Duration Of PMMSY Scheme?
answer: PMMSY will be implemented in all the States and Union Territories for a period of 5(five) | years from FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: What Is The Funding Pattern For Central Sector Scheme?
answer: (a) The entire project/unit cost will be borne by the Central government (i.e. 100% central funding). | (b) Wherever direct beneficiary oriented i.e. individual/group activities are undertaken by the entities of central government including the National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB), the central assistance will be up to 40% of the unit/project cost for the General category and 60% for | SC/ST/Women category.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: What Is The Funding Pattern For Non-Beneficiary Orientated Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
answer: The Non-beneficiary orientated sub-components/activities under CSS component to be implemented by the States/UTs, the entire project/unit cost will be shared between Centre and State as detailed below: | (a) North Eastern & Himalayan States: 90% Central share and 10% State share. | (b) Other States: 60% Central share and 40% State share. | (c) Union Territories (with the legislature and without legislature): 100% Central share.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: What Is The Funding Pattern For Beneficiary-Orientated Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
answer: For the Beneficiary orientated i.e. individual/group activities sub-components/activities under CSS component to be implemented by the States/UTs, the Government financial assistance of both Centre and State/UTs governments together will be limited to 40% of the project/unit cost for General category and 60% of the project/unit cost for SC/ST/Women. The Government's financial assistance will in turn be shared between Centre and State/UTs in the following ratio: | (a) The North Eastern & the Himalayan States: 90% Central share and 10% State share. | (b) Other States: 60% Central share and 40% State share. | (c) Union Territories (with the legislature and without legislature): 100% Central share (No UT Share).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
question: Which Are The End Implementing Agencies (EIAs) In PMMSY?
answer: The PMMSY would be implemented through the following agencies: | (i) Central Government and its entities including National Fisheries Development Board | (ii) State/UT Governments and their entities | (iii) State Fisheries Development Boards | (iv) Any other End Implementing Agencies as decided by the Department of Fisheries

answer: The standard unit cost for a small Biofloc establishment (7 tanks 4mm diameter and 1.5m height) is ₹7,50,000/- per unit.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Small Biofloc Establishment Gujarat
question: What is the percentage of assistance provided for the General Category for a small Biofloc establishment?
answer: The scale of assistance for the General Category is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Small Biofloc Establishment Gujarat
question: How is the assistance for this scheme primarily funded?
answer: Assistance is paid through 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: Who all are eligible to apply for the benefits under this scheme?
answer: Individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir lease holders, and private entities involved in inland fisheries activities can take advantage of the components of this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: What is the minimum age required to be eligible for this scheme?
answer: An applicant must be above 18 years of age to be eligible to apply for the benefits.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: Do I need to own the land to receive construction-related assistance?
answer: To avail of assistance for construction, you must have either your own private land or a land lease agreement for a minimum of 10 years.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: What if the land I want to use for the project is co-owned by others?
answer: If the land is co-owned, you must submit a consent form from all the co-owners to be eligible for the assistance.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: How much assistance will I get for stocking fingerlings in a reservoir?
answer: For stocking fingerlings, you will receive assistance of 40% of the unit cost if you are in the general category, and 60% if you are a woman, or belong to the SC or ST category.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: How is the assistance amount for stocking fingerlings distributed between the government and me?
answer: The assistance is paid through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Government.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: What is the maximum number of fingerlings that can be stocked per hectare under this component?
answer: The standard of assistance for stocking fingerlings in reservoirs is 1,000 fingerlings per hectare.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: How does this scheme help in increasing fish production?
answer: The scheme increases fish production by supporting activities like rearing fish in reservoirs, accelerating inland fish farming in freshwater bodies, and establishing freshwater hatcheries.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
question: What documents are accepted as proof of identity for the application?
answer: You can use a Voter ID, Ration Card, Aadhar Card, or Passport as a valid proof of identity for the application.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Who is eligible to apply for financial assistance under this component?
answer: Any beneficiary who is a native of Gujarat, holds a valid fishing license, and has a boat registered under Real Craft software is eligible.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Is there a requirement for a bank account to receive the benefit?
answer: Yes, the beneficiary must have his or her own active bank account to avail the assistance.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Can I apply more than once for this assistance?
answer: No, the benefit can only be claimed once in a lifetime.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: What is the unit cost considered for upgradation of fishing vessels?
answer: The unit cost is fixed at ₹15.00 lakhs.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: How much assistance is given to a general category beneficiary?
answer: A general category beneficiary can receive 40% assistance, which amounts to ₹6.00 lakhs.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: What percentage of assistance is provided to women, SC, and ST beneficiaries?
answer: Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance, which amounts to ₹9.00 lakhs.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Who decides the allocation of benefits under this component?
answer: The benefit is provided as per the category-wise target allocated by the Government of India.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: What is the contribution pattern between the central and state governments?
answer: The central government contributes 60% and the state government contributes 40% towards the assistance.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Is it mandatory to get approval before purchasing or upgrading the vessel?
answer: Yes, in-principle approval must be obtained before purchasing the floor plan for upgradation.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Where should I register to apply for this assistance?
answer: Beneficiaries need to do online registration through the iKhedut portal at https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: Are small boat owners also eligible for this benefit?
answer: Yes, both small and large boat owners can apply, provided they meet the eligibility criteria.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
question: What is the minimum time limit fixed for reclaiming the benefit under this component?
answer: The minimum time limit prescribed for reclaiming the benefit is once in a lifetime, with no repeat claims allowed.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: Who is eligible to apply under scheme?
answer: General, SC, ST, OBC, Women, and other eligible individuals who have access to land and a water supply source can apply.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: What types of fisheries activities are supported under this scheme?
answer: The scheme supports pond construction, trout sewage units, rearing units, RAS, biofloc units, cage culture, cold storage, motorcycles with ice boxes, fish kiosks, ornamental fisheries, feed mills, hatcheries, and more.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: What is the subsidy amount provided to SC/ST/Women beneficiaries?
answer: SC/ST/Women beneficiaries receive 60% subsidy on the approved project cost.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: What subsidy is available for General category beneficiaries?
answer: General category beneficiaries receive 40% subsidy on the project cost.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: Is there a separate subsidy rate for large RAS units?
answer: Yes, large Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS) units receive a 20% subsidy.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: Where should the application be submitted?
answer: The application must be submitted to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries or District Fisheries In-charge at the district level.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: Will the application process be available online?
answer: Yes. In the future, applications will be processed online through the Apuni Sarkar Portal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: Who approves the final proposal?
answer: The relevant district officer reviews and approves the proposal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
question: How is the subsidy provided to the beneficiary?
answer: After verification, the subsidy is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: By When Can I Claim The Second Installment Of The Cash Incentive?
answer: The 2nd installment can be claimed 180 days after the Last Menstrual Period (LMP) of the applicant.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Does this scheme provides any additional coverages?
answer: Apart from the three installments to be claimed within 150 days, 180 days, and at childbirth, the scheme does not offer additional coverages.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Does the benefit under PMMVY continue in case of death?
answer: No, in an unfortunate event that the child does not survive, the beneficiary is not eligible for benefits under PMMVY for further pregnancies as she has already claimed the installments.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Will the beneficiary get the benefit in case of miscarriage or stillbirth?
answer: The beneficiary will receive the installments until the pregnancy is active. Since the benefit is paid out in three installments depending upon the pregnancy milestones, the beneficiary will receive at least two installments in case of stillbirth. The date of miscarriage will be a factor in deciding whether the benefit will continue or not.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: I have received only the first installment under an old “Maternity Benefit Program (MBP) called Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana (IGMSY). Can I claim the remaining installments under the PMMVY?
answer: Beneficiaries who have received only the first installment under the old MBP (IGMSY) scheme can claim only third installment under the PMMVY scheme, subject to meeting the criteria of PMMVY.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: I Am Expecting Twins, Am I Also Eligible For This Scheme?
answer: Yes, you are eligible to avail the benefits under this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: I Am Already Availing A Paid Maternity Leave From My Employer. Am I Eligible For This Scheme?
answer: No, if you are already availing any paid maternity scheme or a paid maternity leave from your employer, then in that case you won't be eligible for this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: I meet all the eligibility conditions of the Scheme, however, I have applied to receive the benefits of the Scheme after the birth of the child. Am I still eligible to apply?
answer: The beneficiary can apply for benefits under the PMMVY Scheme within 730 days from LMP date or 460 days from the date of Child Birth (in case of unavailability of LMP date) subject to fulfilment of all the other eligibility criteria under the Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Is Last Menstrual Period (LMP) Date Mandatory To Be Provided To Claim Benefits Under The Scheme?
answer: Yes. The LMP Date, as found in the Mother Child Protection (MCP) Card is mandatory to claim the 1st and 2nd installment. If LMP Date is not provided, the beneficiary is not eligible to claim the 1st and 2nd installment and can claim only the 3rd installment provided she fulfils the conditionality for availing third installment of the Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: I Have Forgotten The Password, How Do I Login To The System?
answer: The user can get their password reset using the "Forgot Password" option available below the login space. Also, a user one level above in the system can reset the same [e.g. SO can reset password for a Scheme Facilitator, i.e. Data Entry Operator(DEO)]. The link for password reset is available on User Set up screen - https://pmmvy-cas.nic.in/public/beneficiaryuseraccount/directbeneficiaryusercreation

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Where can one check the bank to which Beneficiary’s Aadhaar is seeded?
answer: The link to check is https://resident.uidai.gov.in/bank-mapper | Beneficiary's mobile number linked with Aadhaar would receive the OTP to check the Bank to which Beneficiary's Aadhaar is seeded.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Is there a Toll-Free Number or email Address where I can enquire about the scheme?
answer: Here are the contact details - | Helpline Number: 011 - 23380329 | Postal Address: | Deputy Director | PMMVY | Department of Women and Child Development | Government of NCT of Delhi | 1, Canning Lane (Pandit Ravi Shankar Shukla Lane) | Near Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan Bus Stop, Kasturba Gandhi Marg | New Delhi - 110 001 | Email Address: | igmsy.hq@gmail.com

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
question: Is There A Cut Off Date For Submission Of Applications?
answer: Yes, the beneficiary can only apply for the scheme within 2 years from the date of beneficiary's Last Menstrual Period subject to the eligibility conditions of the scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
question: Is Khadi Activity Eligible Under PMMY Loans?
answer: Yes. MUDRA loans are applicable for any activity which results in income generation. As Khadi is one of the eligible activities under Textile sector and in case MUDRA loans are taken for income generation, the same can be covered.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
question: Are MUDRA Loans Available For Purchase Of CNG Tempo/Taxi?
answer: MUDRA loans would be available for purchase of CNG Tempo/Taxi, in case the applicant intends to use the vehicle for commercial purposes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
question: I Have A Savings Bank Account With the Bank, Would Loan Under MUDRA Be Available Based On The SB Account?
answer: Yes. The applicant can approach the branch and apply for the loan in the format being provided by the said lending institution. The terms and conditions of the loan will be governed by the policies of the lending institution, based on the broad guidelines of RBI. The loan amount will be decided by the requirement of the proposed income generating activity and the repayment terms will be decided by the anticipated cash flow from the activity.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
question: Under PMMY-Shishu Loans, What Is The Turn Around Time For Processing The Loan Proposal?
answer: As per Banking Codes and Standard Board of India (BCSBI), set up by RBI, loan applications should be disposed off for credit limit up to Rs.5 lakh within 2 weeks.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
question: Is It Required To Submit Income Tax Returns For The Preceding 2 Years For Availing Loan Of Rs. 20 Lakh Under PMMY?
answer: Generally, IT returns are not insisted for small value loans. However, the requirement of documents will be advised by the concerned lending institutions based on their internal guidelines and policies.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Do I qualify for the orphan reservation if both my parents have passed away?
answer: Yes, you are eligible for this reservation if both your biological or adoptive parents have died.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Is the death of my parents required to have occurred at a specific time for me to be eligible?
answer: Yes, both of your parents must have died within 21 years of your birth to be eligible for this reservation.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Am I eligible for this reservation if I live in a private orphanage or a government home?
answer: The reservation is available for orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state of Uttarakhand.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: What kind of services can I get with this orphan certificate?
answer: You can use the certificate to get a 5% horizontal reservation in State Government and Non-Government services.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Where do I need to submit my application to get the Orphan Certificate?
answer: You must submit your application to the District Magistrate's Office or the District Probation Officer's Office of your concerned district.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Which officer is responsible for issuing the Orphan Certificate?
answer: An officer who is not below the rank of a Sub-Divisional Magistrate is the one who issues the certificate.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: What is the role of the District Probation Officer in this process?
answer: The District Probation Officer conducts an investigation and provides a recommendation, based on which the certificate is issued.

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
question: Is this application process for the Orphan Certificate available online?
answer: No, the procedure for obtaining the Orphan Certificate is currently offline.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Is a student receiving any other form of stipend or scholarship funds from a different Government Department simultaneously eligible for this benefit?
answer: No. The student awarded this scholarship shall not hold any other scholarship or stipend that has been disbursed by any other Government Department.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: If I qualify for the Post-Matriculation Scholarship, is there any restriction on me applying for or receiving benefits from other schemes implemented by the department?
answer: Yes, the applicant eligible for the Post-Matriculation Scholarship will generally not be eligible for other schemes in the same year. The sole exception is the "Simon Sing Horo (Special Post-Matric) Scholarship," provided the applicant is otherwise eligible for that scheme.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What are the primary residency and community requirements mandatory for an applicant to successfully qualify for receiving the benefits?
answer: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. Additionally, the student must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: If a student has been detained in a particular class during the previous academic session, will they be allowed to reapply for this scholarship while repeating the same class?
answer: No. If a student is detained in a specific class, he or she shall not be considered eligible to apply for this scholarship for the identical class a second time.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What specific documentation is required to formally verify my community membership during the online application process?
answer: The applicant must produce a valid Caste Certificate. This certificate must be duly certified or issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his or her designated officer.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What specific courses are covered under the Post-Matriculation section of this scheme if I am pursuing studies at the post-secondary stage?
answer: Coverage extends from Class XI up to normal Three Years Degree Courses, such as Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Business Administration, Bachelor of Commerce, or Bachelor of Science. Integrated Graduate plus Post Graduate courses like integrated Master of Business Administration / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Law / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Education / Master of Social Work are also covered.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Are there any specific types of higher education or specialized courses that are explicitly excluded from eligibility for this financial assistance?
answer: Yes. The scholarships are explicitly not available for identified Higher Studies courses. They are also not available for Vocational 3 (three) years Degree Courses or their equivalent.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What evidence must I present during the application process to confirm my current academic enrollment status?
answer: The applicant must produce a recommendation letter from the Headmaster or Principal. Alternatively, the applicant can submit their valid admission or fee receipts.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What is the scope of the Pre-Matriculation Scholarship portion of the scheme regarding the student's current enrollment class?
answer: The Pre-Matriculation Scholarship is awarded specifically to students currently enrolled in Class IX (9) up to Class X (10).

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Does the number of siblings or children from the same household affect the eligibility or limit how many can receive this financial benefit?
answer: No. A special provision states that all children belonging to the same parents or guardians are eligible to apply for the scheme.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Which types of educational institutions must my post-matriculation or post-secondary course be enrolled in for me to be considered eligible?
answer: The scholarships are available only for all recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses. These courses must be pursued in institutions that are recognized by the appropriate authorities.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: What is the maximum annual family income threshold established for applicants to be considered eligible for financial assistance under this scholarship scheme?
answer: The annual family income of the applicant’s family must not exceed ₹5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh) per annum. This information must be submitted via an undertaking provided by the Parent or Guardian.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Am I eligible to apply for this financial assistance if I am currently attending pre-examination training or coaching sponsored by the Government?
answer: No. Students who are undergoing coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers, especially those receiving financial assistance from the Government, are not eligible.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
question: Is it permissible for an applicant to submit multiple scholarship applications from various Sub-Divisions during the same application cycle?
answer: No. The application guidelines strictly state that in no case shall students who apply repeatedly from different Sub-Divisions be considered for the scholarships.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: What is the "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" and who benefits from it?
answer: The Palak Mata-Pita Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat that provides monthly financial assistance to foster parents or guardians who are taking care of orphaned children or children whose surviving parent has remarried after the death of the other parent.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Who is eligible to apply for financial assistance under this scheme?
answer: A person is eligible to apply for this scheme if they are a close relative, guardian, or foster parent of a child between the ages of 0 to 18 years, and if the child’s biological parents are either both deceased or the father is deceased and the mother has remarried.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: What is the financial assistance amount provided through the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana?
answer: Under this scheme, the Government of Gujarat provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3000 directly to the bank account of the eligible foster parent or guardian through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Is there an income limit that applicants must meet to receive benefits under this scheme?
answer: Yes, to qualify for the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana, the applicant’s family income must not exceed ₹27,000/- per year in rural areas and ₹36,000/- per year in urban areas, as certified by a competent authority such as a Magistrate.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Is the scheme applicable to children who still have one surviving parent?
answer: Yes, the scheme also applies to children whose father is deceased and whose mother has remarried, provided the child is not living with the biological parent who remarried.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Is there a specific authority that processes and approves applications under this scheme?
answer: Yes, the applications are reviewed and approved by the Sponsorship and Approval Committee (SFCAC) at the district level, which functions under the leadership of the District Social Security Officer and ensures compliance with government rules.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Is there a cost involved in submitting the application for this scheme?
answer: No, there is no cost or fee associated with submitting the application for the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana as it is completely free of charge.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Are children required to be enrolled in an educational institution to remain eligible for this scheme?
answer: Yes, children above the age of 6 years must be enrolled in a recognized school, and the guardian must submit a certificate every year confirming that the child’s education is ongoing.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: What educational requirement applies to children below 6 years of age?
answer: Children between the ages of 3 and 6 years must be admitted to an Anganwadi center as part of the child development and education support requirements of the scheme.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: What happens if the child discontinues education during the benefit period?
answer: If the child discontinues education or is not enrolled in an educational institution as required, the financial assistance may be withdrawn or discontinued until compliance is re-established.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Where can applicants seek help or clarification regarding the scheme or the application process?
answer: Applicants seeking assistance or clarification can contact the office of the District Social Security Officer or the District Child Protection Officer in their respective district, where they will be guided through the application process and other related procedures.

scheme_name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
question: Is the "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" applicable throughout the state of Gujarat?
answer: Yes, the scheme has been implemented across all districts in the state of Gujarat since its launch on 29th August 2009, and it continues to be available to all eligible applicants statewide.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: What is the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar (PMRBP)?
answer: The Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar is a prestigious award in India given by the Government of India to recognize exceptional achievements and contributions of children in various fields.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: Who organizes the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar?
answer: The award is organized and presented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: What are the categories for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar?
answer: PMRBP is awarded in various categories such as Art & Culture, Innovation, Scholastic, Social Service, Sports, and Bravery.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: Who is eligible for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar?
answer: Children between the ages of 5 to 18 years who have demonstrated exceptional abilities and accomplishments in their respective fields are eligible for nomination.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: Is there a monetary reward associated with the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar?
answer: Yes, along with the honor, recipients of PMRBP receive a medal, and a citation recognizing their exceptional talents and contributions.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: How can applicant apply for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar?
answer: Go to the Official Website of the Rashtriya Puraskar Portal. and click https://awards.gov.in/Home/Awardpedia "New Registration". Guidelines for Registration will appear.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: Who can apply for the awards?
answer: - Individual 2. Organization

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: How Individual can register ?
answer: Step-1: Visit the official website. Step-2: Click on the Registration button. Step-3: Choose type Individual. Step-4: Provide the required details. Step-5: Submit.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: How to register on portal?
answer: Step-1: Visit the official website. | Step-2: Click on login button on portal and login using the credentials. | Step-3: From the list of awards, select scheme name, then click "Nominate / Apply Now". | Step-4: On the next page, fill in all the mandatory fields in the online application form, and then click "Submit".

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
question: What documents are required ?
answer: A copy of the child's birth certificate. | A copy of the child's school leaving certificate. | A copy of the child's Aadhaar card. | A copy of the child's passport size photograph. | A certificate from the child's school or institution, stating that the child has made outstanding contributions in any of the fields specified in the guidelines. | A detailed description of the child's achievements, supported by documentary evidence. | A recommendation letter from a person of eminence in the field in which the child has made outstanding contributions

scheme_name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
question: Could you please clarify which specific group of professionals is primarily targeted by this new research scheme?
answer: The initiative primarily targets top Indian-origin researchers and scientists who are currently working abroad and wishes to bring them back to India to strengthen the research ecosystem.

scheme_name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
question: I am currently working as a scientist outside India; am I eligible to apply for positions under this initiative?
answer: Yes, the scheme is specifically designed to attract and engage global talent of Indian origin who are currently working in foreign countries to lead research in India.

scheme_name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
question: What are the different categories of positions that are being created under this specific research initiative?
answer: The scheme creates positions across three distinct categories: Young Research Fellows, Senior Research Fellows, and Research Chairs to accommodate talent at different career stages.

scheme_name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
question: Could you list the specific priority sectors or research fields that this scheme intends to focus on?
answer: The scheme focuses on 14 nationally significant sectors, including Semiconductors, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Clean Energy, Advanced Materials, Quantum Technologies, Biotechnology, and Space Science.

scheme_name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
question: How many total research positions are expected to be created through this initiative over the specified period?
answer: The government proposes to engage 120 research fellows and chairs across various Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) over a period of five years.
