scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What is EPF Wage?
answer: “EPF Wage” means the wage on which contribution is paid in terms of Section 6 of the EPF and MP Act,1952.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What is meant by “Completed Wage Month” for the purpose of the scheme?
answer: - Completed Wage Month refers to a full calendar month for which an employer has filed the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) in respect of the employees. | - For the purposes of calculating benefits under the scheme: | - If the employee joins on or before the 5th day of a month, then that month shall be treated as the first Completed Wage Month. If the employee joins after the 5th day of a month, then the following month be treated as the first Completed Wage Month.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How employees can register to avail benefits under Part A?
answer: There is no registration process for the employees. They will be provided incentive on the basis of ECR filed by their establishment with EPFO.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Where will the FAT (Facial Authentication Technology) be available for employee UAN aauthentication?
answer: The FAT facility provided on UMANG App will be utilized UAN authentication.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How is the incentive under Part A paid to the First Timer?
answer: It is paid in two instalments directly into the Aadhar seeded bank account of the employees.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How many times incentive will be paid to the Employee during the scheme registration period?
answer: It is a one time incentive to all the eligible First Timers.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What conditions must be met for the Second instalment payment?
answer: The First Timer must: | - Complete the Financial Literacy Course, and | - Have worked for 12 completed months in the same establishment and all 12 months of ECR with contributions is filed by the establishment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How is the second instalment handled?
answer: The second instalment is held in a designated savings or deposit account for a period as specified in future guidelines issued by the Ministry of Labour & Employment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What is the “Financial Literacy Course”?
answer: A mandatory online course covering personal finance, savings, investments, etc. available on EPFO website.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What is the maximum incentive payable to a First Timer under Part A?
answer: The incentive is equal to one completed month’s EPF wage, subject to a maximum of ₹15,000.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Is there any base line for the establishment for incentive to the employee?
answer: No.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Is Aadhaar authentication required for eligibility?
answer: Yes. Only those with FAT authenticated UAN are eligible for benefits.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What happens if an employee leaves voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances?
answer: - If a First Timer leaves the establishment voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances before 06 months then they are not eligible for first installment. | - If a First Timer leaves the establishment voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances after 06 months but before 12 months then they are not eligible for second installment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: An employee has a UAN but never contributed to EPFO or any exempted trust, can they be considered a First Timer?
answer: - If the employee has a UAN but has never had contributions credited to EPFO or an Exempted Trust before the scheme's start date, and the first contribution is received during the scheme registration period, they are considered a First Timer under the scheme. | - They will becomes eligible for the incentives under Part A, provided all other conditions (biometric Aadhaar authentication, continuous ECRs, completion of Financial Literacy course, etc.) are fulfilled.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Can an employee who has worked in an exempted establishment earlier qualify as First Timer?
answer: If an employee was previously a contributing member in an Exempted Trust and now joins EPFO or vice versa, they cannot qualify as a First Timer.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What happens if an employee’s bank account is not linked with Aadhaar?
answer: Payment of incentives to the employee will be suspended until the bank account is Aadhaar-seeded. However, incentives will continue to accrue. Once Aadhaar seeding is done, all pending payments, including arrears, will be released as per the scheme guidelines.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How the benefits will be calculated if the few existing employees (i.e. joined before 01.08.2025) leave or retire?
answer: The payment of incentive will be done only on the basis of Net employment generated above the baseline as calculated and meeting of threshold criteria.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Under Part A in death cases if the employee was eligible for 1st instalment or 2nd instalment as the case may be and before the incentive is credited to the Bank account of the employee will the nominee receive the incentive?
answer: Yes

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: What if an employee joins after the scheme registration period?
answer: Employees who join the establishment after the end of the Scheme registration period are not eligible for incentive benefits under the Scheme. However, for incentive to the establishment such employees will be counted while calculating the Net Additional Employment over and above the baseline and determining threshold fulfillment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: How the employee can generate UAN?
answer: The employee is required to generate UAN using FAT facility as provided on UMANG App and provide the UAN so generated to the employer for filing of ECRs and payment of contributions.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
question: Whether an employee who has generated their own UAN using the UMANG App with Face Authentication can be linked to the employer’s establishment for verification and hence claim benefits under the scheme?
answer: Yes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the "Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector" scheme component?
answer: This component of the scheme is designed to boost employment generation, with a special emphasis on the manufacturing sector. It is an establishment-focused initiative that incentivises the creation of sustained employment across all sectors by providing benefits to eligible establishments for a period of two years. The incentive period for the manufacturing sector is additional 2 years, i.e a total of 4 years.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the incentive Period under the Part B of Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
answer: Under Part B the incentive period is for 02 years for all sectors and 04 Years for the establishments engaged in Manufacturing Sector.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How to register in EPFO?
answer: Any Establishment can register with EPFO through SPICe+ portal of Ministry of Corporate Affairs or Sharm Suvidha Portal of Ministry of Labour & Employment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What details are required for availing benefit of this scheme?
answer: The establishment is required to provide details of PAN/TIN, GSTN, PAN linked Bank Account Number.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How manufacturing sector will be decided?
answer: “Manufacturing” means and includes activities as defined in Section 2(72) of Central Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 as well as mentioned in GSTN certificate of the Establishment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How does the scheme address concerns about temporary or unsustainable job creation?
answer: Eligibility for Part B requires establishments to sustain new employees for at least six months above the baseline.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Are exempted establishments included, and how are they monitored?
answer: Yes, Exempted establishments under the EPF & MP Act, 1952, must file returns and open UANs through EPFO for all their employees, ensuring compliance and transparency in availing benefits.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How do exempted establishments register for the scheme?
answer: - Filing ECR: They must file the Employee Contribution Report (ECR) without contributions in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), providing details of all their employees, including First Timers. | - Aadhaar Authentication: For smooth implementation and transparency, exempted establishments are required to open Aadhaar authenticated Universal Account Numbers (UAN) through EPFO for all existing and new employees.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Whether Existing Establishments Registered with EPFO are Required to Register Anew Under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
answer: No. Establishments already registered with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) are not required to undergo fresh registration under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana. However, these establishments are required to furnish the following details: | - PAN of the establishment | - GSTN (Goods and Services Tax Number) | - PAN-linked bank account number of the employer

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How Can a New Establishment Register with EPFO to Avail Benefits Under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
answer: No separate process is required. New establishments registering through the Shram Suvidha Portal of the Ministry of Labour & Employment or the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) Portal are automatically allotted an PF Code/EPF number at the time of incorporation or registration.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: To which establishments does the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana apply?
answer: The scheme applies to all establishments that are covered under the EPF&MP Act, 1952, including: | Exempted establishments under Section 17 of the Act Subject to fulfilling all applicability conditions laid out in the scheme guidelines.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the baseline for calculating additionality under Part B of the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
answer: The baseline is the average number of employees considered for an establishment to measure net additional employment for incentive eligibility

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How is the baseline calculated for Existing Establishments?
answer: For establishments registered with EPFO prior to 31.07.2024 and regularly filing ECRs with contributions: | - The baseline = Average number of employees as per ECRs over the 12 months from 01.08.2024 to 31.07.2025. | The baseline will be the average number of employees based on filed Electronic Challan-cum-Returns (ECRs) for the 12 months preceding the scheme start date 01.08.2025. ECRs with contributions must have been filed for all 12 preceding months.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How is the baseline calculated for establishments registered between 01.08.2024 and 31.07.2025?
answer: Baseline will be the average number of employees for the months from the date of registration till 31.07.2025, based on ECRs filed with contributions. | The baseline will be the average number of employees from the date of EPFO registration till 01.08.2025. ECRs with contributions must be filed for all completed months during this period.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the baseline for New Establishments registered between 01.08.2025 and 31.07.2027?
answer: The baseline is fixed at 20 employees.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Are only employees with contributions counted for eligibility?
answer: Yes. Only employees for whom contributions are paid through ECR in EPFO or Exempted Trust are counted for additionality, and eligibility calculations.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Can the baseline change if revised ECRs are filed?
answer: No, the baseline remains unchanged once calculated. However, if revised ECRs show a higher number of employees, that higher number will be considered for all scheme purposes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What are the key conditions for establishment eligibility under Part B?
answer: The establishment must hire and sustain new employees (First Timers and Re-joinees) for at least six months beyond the baseline number of employees and meet the meet the threshold criteria based on baseline numbers.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the threshold criterion for Part B?
answer: For establishments with a baseline less than 50 employees: Must add at least 2 employees over baseline. | For establishments with a baseline 50 or more employees: Must add at least 5 employees over baseline.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the upper limit of Threshold criteria in Part B for additional employment generation?
answer: There is no upper limit.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Can an employee with Gross Wages above ₹1 lakh be counted for threshold calculation under Part B?
answer: Yes. Employees with gross wages above ₹1 lakh at the time of joining will be counted for calculating threshold/additionality, but no incentive will be paid in respect of them under the scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Are there any wage limits for employees counted for benefits?
answer: Yes. Benefits will be provided in respect of only those First Timers and Re-joinees whose gross wages are up to ₹1 lakh at the time of joining and who complete six months of employment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How long is the benefit period for existing and new establishments?
answer: - Existing establishments: Benefit period counts for 2 years across all sectors. | - Manufacturing sector: Benefit period counts for 4 years across all sectors. | New establishments: Benefit period counts from the date of EPFO registration for 2 years across all sectors starts and 4 years for manufacturing sector.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What is the periodicity of incentive payment to the establishment ?
answer: Incentive will be paid to the establishment in lumpsum on six monthly basis as per eligibility.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What happens if an establishment does not meet eligibility criteria during some months?
answer: Benefits stop for those months when the criteria are not met but restart once eligibility is regained. However, the overall scheme benefit period remains fixed.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: If an establishment dips below the baseline temporarily, how is the benefit calculated?
answer: If the net employee strength falls below the baseline, the establishment will not be eligible for incentive for that period. Once net strength rises above baseline and the threshold condition is met again, benefits resume — but the scheme period remains fixed and no extension is granted for the lost period.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Can an establishment with the same PAN but different locations avail benefits separately?
answer: No, all establishments with the same PAN will be considered as a single entity for scheme purposes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Are establishments with fewer than 20 employees covered under EPFO eligible for incentives under the scheme?
answer: Yes. Establishments registered with EPFO before 01.08.2025 even with employees less than 20 are eligible to avail benefits provided they meet the other criteria of scheme guidelines.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What happens if an establishment goes bankrupt or enters insolvency during the scheme period?
answer: If an employer is declared bankrupt or enters into insolvency proceedings, the establishment may become ineligible for further incentives under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana. | However, if the establishment continues to make regular EPF contributions for eligible employees despite insolvency proceedings, the incentive will continue.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: What happens if an establishment changes its Bank Account?
answer: If an establishment registered under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana changes its bank account it has to update its account details, and any other details required. | Upon successful verification, future incentive payments are redirected to the updated account. | Failure to update may lead to delay or non-payment of incentive installments.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: If an employee works for 3 months in one establishment and then 3 months in another unit of the same establishment but with different PAN, is the establishment eligible for incentive for these employees?
answer: No. The scheme does not provide benefit to the establishment if the 6-month requirement is met across multiple units having different PAN of the establishments.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How are incentives paid to the establishments?
answer: Incentives to establishments are paid via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the PAN/TAN-linked bank account of the establishment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Are exempted establishments eligible for benefits under the scheme?
answer: Yes, all exempted establishments under the EPF & MP Act, 1952, are eligible to avail benefits under this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How exempted establishments will file ECRs to avail benefits under the scheme?
answer: Exempted establishments must file returns as prescribed by EPFO for each month to avail benefits. For baseline calculation, they need to submit ECRs with employee details for the 12 months preceding August 2025 (from August 2024 to July 2025).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: Is Aadhaar authentication required for employees of exempted establishments?
answer: Yes, exempted establishments are required to open Aadhaar-authenticated Universal Account Numbers (UANs) for all existing and new employees through EPFO. The FAT facility on the UMANG portal can be used to register these employees.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
question: How do exempted establishments register for the scheme?
answer: There is no separate requirement for registration under the scheme. All the establishments including the exempted establishments are deemed to be registered under the scheme. They are required to take following actions: | - Filing ECR: They must file the Employee Contribution Report (ECR) without contributions in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), providing details like joining date, amount of gross salary, amount of contribution etc of all their employees, including First Timers. | - Timely Submission: For calculation of baseline, the exempted establishments are required to file ECRs for 12 months from wage month of August, 2024 to July, 2025 and for availing incentives under the Scheme, they have to file ECRs providing all the details of their employees (existing & new) regularly with EPFO. | - For incentives under Part A of the scheme, exempted establishments are required to file 12 months’ ECRs within 18 months from the date of joining of each First Timer in the establishment. Out of these 12 months' ECRs, first installment under Part A will be provided to the First timers only after receipt of six continuous months' ECRs. However, second instalment will become eligible after filing of total 12 months' ECRs filed during period of 18 months. This relaxation is only for providing incentives under Part A. | - Aadhaar Authentication: For smooth implementation and transparency, exempted establishments are required to open Aadhaar authenticated Universal Account Numbers (UAN) through EPFO for all existing and new employees. | - Further, all exempted establishments are required to provide details like GSTN Certificate, PAN number, PAN linked Bank Account Number etc.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: I am a student currently enrolled in class nine or ten and belong to a Scheduled Tribe; am I eligible to receive financial assistance for my education under this initiative?
answer: Yes, you are eligible for the Pre-Matric Scholarship if you are studying in Standard IX or X, provided your parental annual income falls within the prescribed limits.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: What is the maximum annual income limit for parents or guardians to enable their wards to qualify for the pre-matric or post-matric scholarship benefits?
answer: The parental annual income must be up to ₹2,50,000/- for a student to be eligible for financial assistance under the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship schemes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: Does the government provide financial support for students who have completed their secondary education and wish to pursue higher studies beyond class ten?
answer: Yes, the Post-Matric Scholarship scheme covers all Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class XI and above to support their continued academic advancement.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: What specific demographic criteria regarding population must a village meet to be selected for integrated development and funding for infrastructure gaps?
answer: A village must have at least a 50% tribal population and a total of at least 500 Scheduled Tribes to be identified for development activities under the Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: How much financial assistance is allocated per village to address critical gaps in sectors like connectivity, health, and education under the village development component?
answer: Each identified village is eligible to receive ₹20,38,000/- to bridge gaps in prominent sectors such as road connectivity, schools, health sub-centres, and drinking water facilities.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: Who are the intended beneficiaries of the specific mission launched to improve socio-economic conditions through the provision of secure housing and basic amenities?
answer: The Pradhan Mantri PVTG Development Mission specifically targets Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group families and habitations to provide essential amenities like safe housing, clean drinking water, and sanitation.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
question: Which specific academic levels are covered for quality education under the residential school initiative designed for students in remote tribal areas?
answer: The Eklavya Model Residential Schools are established to provide quality education to Scheduled Tribe students from Class VI to Class XII.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Can students admitted through management quota apply for this loan scheme?
answer: No, applicants admitted through management quota or similar quotas are not eligible for this loan.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Are there any specific course requirements to qualify for this financial support?
answer: Students enrolled in any Course of Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What educational qualifications must the applicant have to apply for this loan?
answer: Students admitted through open competitive examinations/merit based admissions can apply for loan under PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What is the maximum annual family income to qualify for the 3% interest subvention?
answer: The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 to be eligible for the 3% interest subvention.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Can a student avail this loan if they are already receiving another government scholarship?
answer: No, applicants receiving any other Central or State Government scholarship, interest subvention, or fee reimbursement are not eligible.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Is there an age limit for students applying for this financial assistance program?
answer: All students who get merit-based admission in Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs) are eligible under PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What kind of admission is required to be eligible for this education loan?
answer: The applicant must secure merit-based admission to one of the 860 designated Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) in India.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What types of institutions are considered eligible under this scheme?
answer: Eligible institutions include top 100 ranked HEIs in NIRF rankings, top 200 state/UT government HEIs in NIRF rankings, and all HEIs under the Government of India.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Are foreign education institutions or their Indian campuses eligible under this scheme?
answer: No, Indian campuses of foreign institutions, foreign campuses of Indian institutions, and foreign institutions are not covered.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What are the password requirements for creating an account on the portal?
answer: The password must be at least 8 characters long, with a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Can applicants select their preferred bank for loan processing?
answer: Yes, applicants can choose their preferred bank and branch from the dropdown menu during the application process.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Is there an option to download the submitted loan application?
answer: Yes, applicants can download a PDF copy of their application from the "Track Loan Application" section.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: How is the interest subvention amount credited to the student?
answer: The subsidy amount will be credited to PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL RUPEE APP (CBDC WALLET) of the beneficiary and on redemption on the app by the beneficiary, the amount will be transferred to the beneficiary loan account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What is the maximum loan amount eligible for a 75% credit guarantee?
answer: The Government of India provides a 75% credit guarantee for loans up to ₹7,50,000, irrespective of family income.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What is the interest rate cap for loans under this scheme?
answer: The interest rate is capped at the bank’s Externally Benchmarked Lending Rate (EBLR) plus 0.5%.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: Is there any additional interest concession available for timely repayments?
answer: Yes, up to 1% additional interest concession is provided if interest is serviced during the study and moratorium period.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What is the maximum repayment period allowed for this education loan?
answer: The repayment period can extend up to 15 years, excluding the moratorium period (course duration plus one year).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
question: What is PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL RUPEE APP?
answer: - PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL RUPEE App is a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) based dedicated mobile application for receiving education loan interest subvention benefits from Dept. Of Higher Education Ministry of Education GoI. | - The application is available for download at Play store for android based mobiles and App store for i-phones | - Mobile number of beneficiaries updated in PM-Vidyalaxmi portal by the financing Bank, against beneficiary claim should be used for downloading the application. | - Beneficiaries can activate their PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL Rupee App through AADHAAR based authentication process via OTP received in their AADHAAR registered Mobile number. | - PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL Rupee App is applicable for both PM VIDYALAXMI and CSIS interest subvention schemes of Dept. Of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, GoI.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: What is the main purpose of the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy"?
answer: The main purpose of the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" is to encourage farmers in Gujarat to adopt organic farming practices by providing them with financial assistance for organic certification, registration, transportation, and organic input costs in order to promote sustainable agriculture and reduce the dependency on chemical-based farming.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: Who is eligible to apply under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy"?
answer: Any individual engaged in farming and residing in Gujarat, who wishes to pursue or is already practicing organic farming, is eligible to apply under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy", provided they fulfill basic requirements such as possessing land records and registering on the iKhedut portal.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: What type of financial assistance is provided under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy"?
answer: Under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy", farmers receive up to 75% assistance for certification through the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA), 50% assistance for registration, certification, and transportation through APEDA-approved agencies, and input assistance of ₹5,000/- per hectare to support organic cultivation.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: Is there any upper limit on the assistance provided under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy"?
answer: Yes, under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy", the maximum assistance available for certification is capped at ₹2,000/- per hectare, while the input assistance is limited to ₹5,000 per hectare, ensuring that the support is fairly distributed among eligible farmers.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: Is the scheme applicable to all districts of Gujarat?

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
question: Is there any cost associated with applying under the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy"?
answer: There is no cost associated with applying for the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy", as the application process is completely free and can be carried out online through the government’s official portal.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy

answer: No, individuals who are not residents of Gujarat are not eligible to apply for the scheme, as the scheme is exclusively for residents of the state.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy

answer: There are no income restrictions or income limits imposed under the scheme. Individuals from all economic backgrounds may apply.

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy

answer: To apply for the scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy", a farmer must submit key documents such as the 7/12 Land Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Bank Pass Book or a cancelled cheque, and, in applicable cases, certification documents from GOPCA or APEDA-approved agencies.
