scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: What are the different categories of applicants and how do the benefits differ between them for this literature preservation initiative?
answer: There are 3 categories: Category I covers deceased or inactive tiatr artistes who receive 25 free copies and honorarium; Category II covers active tiatr artistes who get 200 free copies and honorarium; Category III covers individual artistes or publishers who get 100% printing cost coverage but no honorarium and must provide 100 books to the Academy.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: As someone wanting to submit only song lyrics without any dramatic scripts, what is the minimum collection requirement I need to meet?
answer: If you are submitting only songs (kantaram) with or without musical scores, you need a minimum collection of 50 songs if you fall under Category I (deceased or inactive artiste), or 100 songs if you fall under Category II (active artiste).

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: Can I apply for this literature preservation support if I am not personally involved in tiatr but am related to someone who was?
answer: Yes, you can apply as a legal heir of a deceased tiatr artiste. You must be able to establish your legal relationship to the deceased artiste who was involved in tiatr performances or creation.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: What happens if my submitted manuscript contains content that criticizes government policies or makes comments about religious communities?
answer: The Academy reserves the right not to print your book and can refrain from making payment or even recall payments already made if your scripts or lyrics contain adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion that may hurt sentiments.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: In what specific language and script format must my manuscript be prepared for consideration under this preservation initiative?
answer: Your manuscript must be prepared in Konkani language written in Roman Script format. All scripts, lyrics, and musical compositions must adhere to this language and script requirement as specified by the Academy.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: How many physical copies of my manuscript do I need to submit along with my application for review?
answer: You must submit 3 typed copies of your manuscript along with your application. Additionally, you also need to provide a soft copy on a Compact Disc, Digital Versatile Disc, or Pen Drive.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: What is the minimum number of book copies that will be printed if my manuscript gets approved for publication?
answer: The Academy will print a minimum of 500 copies of each approved book. This ensures adequate distribution and preservation of the tiatr literature for future generations and cultural documentation.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: If I am currently performing and writing for tiatr productions, which category should I apply under and what benefits can I expect?
answer: As an active tiatr artiste, you should apply under Category II. You will receive 200 copies of your published book, a one-time honorarium fixed by the Academy for each script or anthology, and the Academy will fund the entire publication from its allocated scheme funds.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: Are there any financial documents I need to provide as part of my application submission process?
answer: Yes, you must submit a self-attested copy of your Permanent Account Number Card along with a self-attested copy of your Aadhaar Card as part of the required documentation.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: What type of dramatic works are eligible for consideration beyond traditional full-length tiatr productions?
answer: Besides full-length tiatrs, you can submit scripts of Khell tiatr, Khell productions, and One Act Plays. The scheme covers various forms of dramatic literature within the tiatr tradition and related theatrical formats.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: If I want to publish my work independently but still receive financial support, what obligations do I have toward the Academy?
answer: Under Category III, you must ensure your book conforms to all scheme norms, provide 100 books to the Academy free of cost, and you will receive 100% printing cost reimbursement but no honorarium payment.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: How can I obtain the official application form required for submitting my manuscript for consideration?
answer: The prescribed application form is available at the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa. You need to collect this specific form as it is required along with your other documents for application submission.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: What additional documentation do I need if I am applying as a publisher on behalf of an author rather than as the original creator?
answer: If you are applying as a publisher, you must provide a written No Objection Certificate from the original author in addition to all other required documents including manuscript copies and identification papers.

scheme_name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
question: Which type of tiatr literature receives priority consideration during the evaluation and selection process?
answer: Scripts, lyrics, and music written by tiatr artistes of yesteryears are given first preference during the evaluation process. This prioritization helps preserve historical and culturally significant works from earlier generations.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What documents do I need to submit when applying, and are there any specific requirements for these documents?
answer: You must submit a self-attested copy of your Aadhaar Card and a self-attested copy of your PAN Card at the application stage. These copies should be properly self-attested before submission.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: If I want to purchase a more expensive instrument than the medium-priced range, will I receive a higher subsidy amount?
answer: No, even if you choose to purchase a higher-cost instrument, the subsidy calculation will be based only on the value of a medium-priced instrument. You have the flexibility to buy a costlier instrument, but the 50% refund remains tied to medium-priced instrument values.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: How long do I need to commit to performing on the tiatr stage after completing my course?
answer: You must provide an undertaking to serve the tiatr stage by playing in any tiatr band or musical group for at least 1 year after course completion. This commitment is mandatory and must be formally documented through a written undertaking submitted to the Academy.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What happens if I cannot keep up with the course syllabus or am not showing adequate progress during my training?
answer: Students who cannot cope with the syllabus or are found not serious in their learning may be terminated from the scheme. This decision will be made after an evaluation report from the expert panel of musicians appointed by the Academy.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: Are there any age restrictions that would prevent me from applying for financial assistance to learn blowing instruments?
answer: No, there are no age restrictions as any interested person, whether young or adult, is free to avail the benefits. The scheme is open to all individuals regardless of their age who wish to learn blowing instruments for tiatr music.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What type of financial support is available for obtaining professional certifications from recognized international music institutions?
answer: The scheme provides appropriate financial support for students to register and get themselves certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music. The Academy encourages pursuing these advanced certifications and offers monetary assistance for the same.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: How long does the complete course duration extend, and what is the structure of the training program?
answer: The course is structured into 2 levels and spans over a period of 2 years, or as otherwise determined by the expert panel. The syllabus is framed by expert musicians appointed by the Academy, and students must undergo periodical tests throughout.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: Do I need to find my own music teacher, and what are the requirements for tutor selection?
answer: Yes, you must identify a tutor who possesses the necessary credentials to teach the chosen blowing instrument. The Academy will verify and accept the tutor's credentials, and it's advisable to consult with the teacher regarding instrument selection.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What is the exact reimbursement amount I can expect for the tuition fees paid to my music instructor?
answer: The scheme provides reimbursement of tuition fees paid to the tutor, with the exact amount to be decided by the Academy. The specific reimbursement amount is determined by the Academy based on their assessment and guidelines.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: When and how should I submit the bill for my purchased instrument to claim the subsidy?
answer: You must submit a self-attested Xerox copy of the bill immediately after purchasing the instrument during the course. Upon successful course completion, you need to submit the original bill to claim the 50% subsidy refund.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: Will I definitely receive the 50% instrument subsidy upon course completion, or are there any conditions that might affect this?
answer: The 50% subsidy refund is subject to the availability of funds and requires you to complete the full course successfully. You must also submit the original bill and undertaking upon course completion to be eligible for disbursement.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What specific blowing instruments are covered under this financial assistance program for learning tiatr music?
answer: The scheme covers blowing instruments crucial for tiatr music, specifically Saxophone, Trumpet, and Clarinet. You can choose any of these instruments, and the 50% subsidy applies to the purchase cost of these instruments.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: What responsibilities does my chosen tutor have regarding attendance and progress reporting throughout the course duration?
answer: Your tutor must maintain a record of attendance for students and submit it to the Academy regularly. The tutor is also responsible for submitting merit reports to help finalize applicant names and assess student progress.

scheme_name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
question: Besides the instrument subsidy, what other certificates or recognition will I receive upon successfully completing this music training program?
answer: Upon successful completion of the course, you will receive official certificates awarded by the Academy, acknowledging your achievement and new musical skills. The Academy also provides music classes at their Conference Hall and supports advanced certifications.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: What is this scheme, and how can it help me as a pig farmer?
answer: This scheme provides financial assistance to entrepreneurs in pig farming by offering a 50% capital subsidy (up to [?]30 lakh) for setting up a breeder farm. It aims to improve pig productivity, reduce pork imports, and promote scientific rearing practices.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: How much financial assistance will I receive?
answer: The government provides 50% of the total project cost, up to a maximum of [?]30 lakh, as a one-time capital subsidy. The remaining amount must be arranged through a bank loan, financial institution, or self-financing.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: Will I get the subsidy amount directly in my bank account?
answer: No, the subsidy is released in two instalments through SIDBI to the lending bank or financial institution. The first instalment is given after loan disbursement, and the second is released after project completion and verification.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: How much financial assistance will I receive?
answer: The government provides 50% of the total project cost, up to a maximum of [?]30 lakh, as a one-time capital subsidy. The remaining amount must be arranged through a bank loan, financial institution, or self-financing.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: Will I get the subsidy amount directly in my bank account?
answer: No, the subsidy is released in two instalments through SIDBI to the lending bank or financial institution. The first instalment is given after loan disbursement, and the second is released after project completion and verification.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: What are the conditions for setting up a pig breeding farm?
answer: You must establish a breeder farm with at least 100 sows and 25 boars, sourced from government farms, university farms, or local farmers with high genetic merit.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: What happens if I don’t complete the project?
answer: If the project is not completed as per guidelines, the second instalment of the subsidy will not be released. For self-financed projects, the bank guarantee may be invoked.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: Can I avail of this subsidy without taking a loan?
answer: Yes, but if you are self-financing, your project must be appraised by a bank, and you must provide a bank guarantee for the remaining project cost beyond the subsidy amount.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: How long will my project be monitored after receiving the subsidy?
answer: The State Implementing Agency will monitor the project for two years to ensure proper implementation.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: When will I receive the first installment of the subsidy?
answer: The first instalment is released after your loan is sanctioned and disbursed by the bank, and the State Implementing Agency confirms it.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: Are there any additional requirements for self-financing applicants?
answer: Yes, self-financing applicants must spend at least 25% of the project cost on infrastructure before receiving the first instalment and submit a bank guarantee valid for three years.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: Who do I contact for more details or assistance?
answer: You should contact the State Implementing Agency of your State Animal Husbandry Department under the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry, and Dairying for application procedures and support.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
question: What kind of equipment and infrastructure are covered under the scheme?
answer: The subsidy supports housing, breeding stock, transportation, insurance, and essential equipment/machinery. A detailed list of eligible equipment is provided in the scheme guidelines.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: As a micro-enterprise owner looking to participate in government tenders, what special price matching benefit is available when competing against larger companies?
answer: If your quoted price falls within 15% of the lowest price quoted by non-micro/small enterprises, you can match their price to win the tender. In cases where multiple micro or small enterprises fall within this range, the one with the lowest quote gets preference.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: How much financial turnover should my enterprise maintain to be eligible for preferential purchase benefits from the Goa government?
answer: Your enterprise must have an annual turnover not exceeding Rs. 6 crores for the last three consecutive financial years to qualify for these benefits. This limit applies to both micro and small enterprises.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: What documentation is required to prove my eligibility for receiving preferential treatment in government tenders in Goa?
answer: You must have permanent registration or acknowledgement with Entrepreneurs Memorandum II from the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Goa. This is a mandatory requirement to access any benefits under the scheme.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: How much would I need to pay as earnest money when participating in government tenders as a micro or small enterprise?
answer: The maximum earnest money deposit required is Rs. 500, which is significantly lower than what might be required from larger enterprises. Additionally, no other security deposit is required.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: What is the maximum cost I would need to pay to obtain tender documents as a micro or small enterprise?
answer: The tender documents will be provided to you at a maximum cost of Rs. 200, which is a special concession for micro and small enterprises participating in government tenders.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: Within what timeframe can I expect payment from government departments after delivering goods or completing tendered work?
answer: The department must make payment within 60 days from the delivery of goods or completion of work. If they fail to do so, they are liable to pay interest at 0.75% per month.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: If I am bidding for contracts involving installation and commissioning of machinery, what special consideration is given to my quoted price?
answer: A pro-rata percentage adjustment above the lowest quotation will be granted to your enterprise to qualify for matching the lowest bid, provided you meet other eligibility criteria.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: As a micro-enterprise selling computer hardware and electronic items, can I avail of the preferential purchase benefits for government tenders?
answer: Yes, you can avail these benefits for computer hardware and electronic items tenders, except for purchases specifically made by the Education Department.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: What quality standards must my enterprise maintain to be eligible for the preferential purchase benefits?
answer: Your enterprise must match the quality standards as required by the State Government Department. This is a non-negotiable condition for availing any benefits under the scheme.

scheme_name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme
question: What types of government entities are required to provide these preferential purchase benefits to eligible enterprises?
answer: These benefits must be provided by all Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Corporations, and Semi-Government Departments when floating tenders or making purchases.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: What is Pada Pushti Karyakrama?
answer: Pada Pushti Karyakrama is a special nutrition programme in Odisha to provide supplementary nutrition such as hot cooked meals and morning snacks to children aged 3 - 6 years living in remote and hard-to-reach villages that do not have Anganwadi Centres.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: Who are the beneficiaries of this programme?
answer: Children aged 3-6 years residing in hamlets or villages that are remote/hard-to-reach and where access to regular Anganwadi services is limited or unavailable.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: How is the food provided to the children?
answer: Food is provided through spot feeding at the village level, including hot cooked meals and morning snacks, prepared locally by community members or designated workers.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: Who prepares and distributes the meals?
answer: The meals are typically prepared and distributed by Mother Groups or a designated Pushti Sakhi/volunteer at the hamlet level through community participation.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: How frequently are meals provided?
answer: Meals are typically served six days a week, similar to the regular SNP pattern, to ensure regular nutrition intake.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: What types of food are included?
answer: The meals include a combination of hot cooked foods (e.g., rice with dal/vegetables) and nutritious morning snacks appropriate for children aged 3-6 years as per the guidelines.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: How are beneficiaries identified?
answer: Eligible children are identified based on their age (3-6 years) and residence in hard-to-reach villages/hamlets that lack an Anganwadi centre.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: What defines a “hard-to-reach” village?
answer: Villages are defined as “hard-to-reach” if they do not have an Anganwadi Centre nearby and face geographical or access barriers that prevent children from attending regular services.

scheme_name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
question: Are growth measurements of children taken?
answer: Yes, growth monitoring including height and weight measurements is carried out periodically at nearby Anganwadi Centres.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What is the primary objective of this scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for the construction of new ponds in saline or alkaline areas.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: For what type of water bodies is the polythene lining cost provided?
answer: The polythene lining cost is provided for new water bodies created under various state government initiatives.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: When is the central assistance for polythene lining cost released?
answer: Central assistance for the polythene lining cost is released only after the ponds are ready for fish/shrimp culture.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: Are projects on leased land eligible for central financial assistance under this scheme?
answer: Yes, projects having land on long-term lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What is the minimum lease period required for land to be eligible under the scheme?
answer: The registered lease period or agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What is the maximum subsidy provided under this scheme?
answer: The subsidy will be limited to 25% of the project cost for all categories.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What is the first document required from the beneficiary for this scheme?
answer: The first document required is an Agreement deed between the beneficiary and the Fisheries Department.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What documents can be submitted as proof of Date of Birth?
answer: A Voting Card, Birth Certificate, Aadhar Card, or Matriculation Certificate can be submitted as proof of Date of Birth.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What type of land record is needed if the land is owned by the beneficiary?
answer: If the land is owned, Jamabandi, Nakal Akshizra, and Farad from the Tehsil are required.

scheme_name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
question: What document is needed as a land record if the land is leased?
answer: A registered lease deed of a minimum of 7 years is required as a land record if the land is leased.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: If student has availed subsidy under any other scheme including the CSIS scheme for undergraduate courses, whether he/she will be eligible under this scheme?
answer: Student will be eligible, (as the interest subsidy) under the Scheme for pursuing Post Graduate Diploma, Post Graduate degree course/Masters, M.Phil & Ph.D. Further, those students, who have completed M.Tech in India but is now pursuing MBA abroad and these students have got subsidy under CSIS/ state subsidy scheme for the M.Tech course, are also be eligible in this Scheme.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: Is Interest Subsidy guaranteed for all eligible applicants?
answer: No, interest subsidy is not guaranteed for all eligible applicants. However, it would be Ministry's endeavor to provide interest subsidy to all eligible applicants to the extent possible. As per provision of scheme, total number of students to be selected in a year is 400.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: As per Model Scheme of IBA, the maximum loan for study abroad is Rs.20 lakhs. Whether interest subsidy is admissible for loan amount disbursed above Rs.20.00 lakh?
answer: Presently, subsidy is restricted to the limits specified under IBA model scheme i.e. Rs 20.00 lakh only

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: Whether latest income certificate only should be obtained or the income certificate obtained during earlier years/ at the time of availing loan can be taken?
answer: Income Certificate issued by Competent Authority obtained at the time of availing loan, will be sufficient

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: What documents are required ?
answer: - Application form. | - Admission letter. | - Passport. | - Income certificate. | - Education loan application. | - Aadhaar card.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: What is the ‘Meritorious’ element in the Scheme for eligibility for interest subsidy?
answer: Those who have secured admission abroad and are eligible as per Scheme Guidelines will be considered as meritorious under the Scheme.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: If the course pursued by the minority student is partly in India and partly abroad, shall be eligible for the interest subsidy?
answer: Such students will be eligible for interest subsidy, if the Degree is awarded by Foreign University.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: What is the income limit under the scheme?
answer: Total income from all sources of the employed candidate or his/ her parents/guardians in case of unemployed candidate shall not exceed Rs. 6.00 lakh per annum. Income certificate issued by the competent authority in the State/ Union Territory should be submitted in support of income shown by a candidate.

scheme_name: Padho Pardesh
question: When can a student apply for the scheme benefits?
answer: Students must apply for the scheme's benefits during their first year of study. Applications received in the second year or later will not be accepted.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: Who administers the Pension Plan scheme?
answer: The scheme is administered by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB), under the Labour Department of the Government of Meghalaya.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: Who is eligible to receive pension benefits under this scheme?
answer: The registered workers who have been working as building workers for not less than one year shall be eligible to receive pension benefits under the scheme.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: At what age does a registered worker become eligible for pension benefits?
answer: Registered workers become eligible for pension benefits upon attaining the age of 60 years.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: What is the amount of pension provided under this scheme?
answer: Registered workers who meet the eligibility criteria receive an amount of [?]1,000/- per month as pension.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: When does the pension become payable?
answer: Pension becomes payable from the 60th year succeeding the month in which the beneficiary completes 60 years of age.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: What is the minimum duration of work required to qualify for pension benefits?
answer: The beneficiary should have worked as a building worker for not less than one year to be eligible for pension benefits.

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: How does one apply for pension benefits under this scheme?
answer: Applications can be made online at http://megbocwwb.gov.in/bocw_services

scheme_name: Pension Plan (MBOCWWB)
question: Can the application be tracked?
answer: Yes, applications can be tracked from the Dashboard after logging into http://megbocwwb.gov.in/bocw_services

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: Who can apply under this scheme?
answer: Farmers, registered organizations, and groups engaged in aromatic plant cultivation in Uttarakhand are eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: Is registration with CAP mandatory for applicants?
answer: Yes. The farmer, organization, or group must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: What kind of financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
answer: A grant of up to ₹10 lakh is provided for setting up machinery, equipment, and distillation units for drying, storage, and processing of aromatic plants.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: What is the subsidy rate under this scheme?
answer: A subsidy of 75% of the expenditure is provided in hilly areas, and 50% in plain areas, through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: What types of facilities are supported?
answer: Facilities for drying, storage, distillation, and processing of aromatic plants are supported under this scheme.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: How can a farmer apply for setting up a distillation plant?
answer: Farmers can obtain the application form from the CAP website or through field personnel and submit it to the Director of CAP or via a field worker in the prescribed format.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: What is the process after application submission?
answer: After submission, the District Coordinator conducts a site inspection and provides a recommendation. Based on this, the Director of CAP issues written permission to establish the distillation plant.

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
question: When can the applicant apply for the subsidy disbursement?
answer: After establishing the distillation plant as per CAP’s permission, the applicant can apply for subsidy disbursement using the prescribed form available on the CAP website or through field workers.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Can our dance group use a mixture of different patriotic songs to create a more diverse performance for the competition?
answer: No, only one patriotic song in Konkani must be used to perform the dance. No fusion of different songs will be considered for evaluation.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: What is the minimum and maximum number of students that can participate as dancers in our school's group?
answer: Each participating group should consist of not less than 6 or more than 10 dancers to be eligible for the competition.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Are there different competition categories based on the age or standard of our participating students?
answer: Yes, the competition is held in two categories: Standard 1st to Standard 4th and Standard 5th to Standard 10th.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: How much traveling allowance will our school receive if we are located 25 kilometers away from the venue?
answer: Participating groups coming from a distance of 20 kilometers or more will be paid ₹4,000/- as traveling allowance.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: What happens if our school applies after 25 other schools have already registered for the competition?
answer: Only 25 participating troupes will be permitted in the competition on first come first serve basis, so late applications may not be accepted.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Is it mandatory to provide the recorded song along with our application form submission?
answer: Yes, participants should furnish a recorded copy of the song on Compact Disc along with the application form, and the Compact Disc is returnable.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: What prize money can we expect if our group from Standard 1st to 4th category wins the first position?
answer: The 1st Prize for Standard 1st to Standard 4th category is ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: How much traveling allowance will be provided if our school is located within 15 kilometers from the competition venue?
answer: Participating groups coming from within a radius of more than 10 kilometers and less than 20 kilometers will be paid ₹3,000/- as traveling allowance.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Will refreshments be arranged for our students and the teacher accompanying them to the competition venue?
answer: Yes, refreshments will be provided for the participants and their in-charge during the competition.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: What is the prize amount for the best choreographer award in the Standard 5th to 10th category?
answer: The Best Choreographer award for both categories carries a prize of ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Can we challenge or appeal against the judges' decision if we are not satisfied with the results?
answer: No, the panel of judges' decision will be final and binding, and no appeals or challenges are permitted.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: How much prize money will our school receive if we secure the second position in Standard 5th to 10th category?
answer: The 2nd Prize for Standard 5th to Standard 10th category is ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Will our school receive any traveling allowance if we are located just 8 kilometers away from the competition venue?
answer: Yes, participating groups coming from within a radius of 10 kilometers will be paid ₹2,000/- as traveling allowance.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: What is the monetary reward for achieving third position in the Standard 1st to 4th age group competition?
answer: The 3rd Prize for Standard 1st to Standard 4th category is ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
question: Can the organizing authority make changes to the competition rules after we have submitted our application form?
answer: Yes, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules as per their discretion.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What type of organizations or individuals are eligible to participate in this cultural promotion initiative?
answer: An individual, organization, educational institution, or club can apply for this scheme to promote patriotism and national integration through cultural performances.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: How much advance notice is required when submitting an application for a cultural performance under this program?
answer: The application along with typed script or lyrics should reach the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days before the date of staging the programme.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What documentation is needed if someone other than the applicant has written or directed the proposed performance?
answer: If the applicant is not the lyricist, writer, or director of the activity proposed, then No Objection Certificate from the lyricist, writer, or director concerned must be attached to the application.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: Are there any restrictions on the content that can be included in the scripts or lyrics of the performance?
answer: There should not be any adverse remark made in any form either written or verbal against any Governments, Individuals, Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts, lyrics of songs, performances, or speeches which may hurt the sentiments of anybody.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What is the minimum duration requirement for musical programmes or tiatrs submitted under this cultural scheme?
answer: Duration of the musical programme or tiatr should be not less than two hours to qualify for this scheme.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: How many performances will be organized and what is the cost structure for audiences attending these shows?
answer: A maximum of 4 shows of such a programme will be staged by Tiatr Academy of Goa at various places and all shows must be shown to public free of charge.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What type of financial compensation and additional support is provided to successful applicants under this program?
answer: A remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be given to the applicant, and besides the remuneration, Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse the actual charges of the hall or auditorium or pay a lump sum amount if the performance is held in a makeshift pandal.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What specific identity documents must be submitted along with the application for this cultural promotion initiative?
answer: The concerned who wants to avail the benefit of this scheme shall submit self attested copies of Aadhaar and Permanent Account Number Card along with the application.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: How does the selection process work and what determines the order in which applications are processed?
answer: The scheme will be implemented on 'First Come First Serve' basis and applications will be considered as per the availability of funds.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What promotional acknowledgment requirements must be followed when advertising or publicizing the approved cultural performances?
answer: In all advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners, the following must be inserted, published, or announced: 'This programme is promoted by Tiatr Academy of Goa'.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: Are applicants permitted to seek additional financial sponsorship from external sources for their cultural programmes?
answer: Tiatr Academy of Goa has no objection if sponsorship is taken by the producer from other sources for the programme.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What arrangements must be made regarding seating and guest protocol for the cultural performances under this scheme?
answer: A few seats should be reserved by the organizer for the representatives of Tiatr Academy of Goa, and the organizing institution or individual will have to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What documentation and recording facilities are provided to participants after completion of their cultural performance?
answer: Video recording of the activity or programme will be done by Tiatr Academy of Goa and one copy of the Digital Video Disc will be given to the applicant.

scheme_name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
question: What display requirements exist regarding official banners during the staging of approved cultural programmes?
answer: Tiatr Academy of Goa will give one banner which should be compulsorily displayed at one of the two front side wings of the stage, and the banner should be returned back to Tiatr Academy of Goa after all the shows are staged.

scheme_name: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
question: What is the purpose of the "Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra"?
answer: The purpose of the "Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra" is to provide free pre-examination training to candidates preparing for various competitive exams.

scheme_name: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
question: Who is eligible to apply for the training program?
answer: Candidates who are residents of the specified state, belong to the eligible categories, and meet the educational and socio-economic criteria can apply.

scheme_name: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
question: What types of exams are covered under this scheme?
answer: The scheme covers exams such as Civil Services, SSC, and other government competitive examinations.

scheme_name: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
question: Is there any fee for participating in the training program?
answer: No, the training program is offered free of cost to all eligible candidates.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Is Ramanujan fellow eligible to apply for Core Research grant proposal?
answer: Yes, Ramanujan fellows are eligible to apply for Core Research grant proposal.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What are the eligibility criteria for applying for Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: Following are the eligibility criteria for applying Ramanujan Fellowship: | The fellowship is open to brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world who are below the age of 40 years, who wants to return to India from abroad. | The applicant should possess a higher degree or equivalent, such as Ph.D. in Science/Engineering, Masters in Engineering or Technology/MD in Medicine, etc. and have adequate professional experience. | These Fellowships are very selective and only those who have a proven/outstanding track-record as evident from their research publications and recognitions would be eligible. | In case a fellow is offered a permanent position, he/she will be in-eligible for the fellowship. | This fellowship is meant for working in new areas and laboratories in order to expand their research capabilities, other than the one, where the candidate has obtained his/her doctorate degree. | Nominations from the Ph.D guides of the candidate and nominations from the same institute where they opted their Ph.D, will not be considered. | The age of the candidate should not be more than 40 years. | The candidate should be working abroad at the time of his nomination for the fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the duration of the Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: The Ramanujan Fellowship duration is for 5 years only.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: How/When can the individual start his Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: A letter is sent by the Science & Engineering Research Board (SERB) to the Individual as well as to the host Institute informing the award of Ramanujan Fellowship. After this the Individual has to join the fellowship within six months of the date of approval letter and to send his / her Acceptance Letter to the Host Institute, indicating the tentative month when he wants to start the Fellowship, and then the Institute will forward his Acceptance Letter to Science &Engineering Research Board along with the details of the bank for transfer of fund through RTGS(in the prescribed format). Based on this letter SERB will process the case for getting administrative and financial approvals and then a Sanction Order is issued to the Host Institute (marking a copy to the Ramanujan Fellow) and a copy to the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, SERB for disbursing the grant under Ramanujan Fellowship. When the grant money is received by the Host Institute, the Ramanujan Fellow can start his/ her Fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the nature of support the Ramanujan Fellow is entitled for?
answer: For Fellows who will be availing the Ramanujan fellowship after 31.12.2018, the revised funding pattern of Ramanujan fellows is as follows: | Ramanujan Fellow is entitled for a Fellowship of [?]1,35,000/- consolidated per month(including HRA component) | The fellowship will carry a research grant of [?]7.00 Lakh per annum. and overhead charges of [?]60,000/- to the host institute until the fellow is not having any position in India. | In case the selected fellow gets any position such as permanent, tenure track or contractual position, he/she, will become in-eligible for receiving fellowship including research grant and overhead under the fellowship and has to relinquish the Ramanujan fellowship in total. | For fellows who have already started availing this fellowship on or before 31.12.2018,(viz. sanction order of SERB issued on or before 31.12.2018) such fellows on acquiring a job(permanent, tenure track or contractual position) will be allowed to draw the research grant and overhead charges as indicated at (ii) above. Only the fellowship component will be discontinued as indicated by (i) above.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the emoluments under Ramanujan Fellowship for HRA?
answer: SERB gives only consolidated fellowship of [?]1,35,000/- p.m (including HRA component) per month.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can a person avail grants under Ramanujan Fellowship and Salary from the Institute at the same time?
answer: No, A person can opt either to avail his/ her salary from the Institute or Fellowship amount under Ramanujan Fellowship and it is applicable to the fellows those who have started the fellowship on or before 31.12.2018(after the issuance of the sanction order on or before 31.12.2018 as per terms and conditions of latest O.M. dated 01-01-2019). | Fellows who get a permanent position after 31.12.2018 (issuance of sanction order happened after 31.12.2018), will relinquish the Ramanujan fellowship in total in case they get salary from institute on getting permanent, tenure track or on contractual basis.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can a fellow change the host institute after getting Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: - Yes, in case the Ramanujan fellow who is availing fellowship (first sanction order issued on or before 31.12.2018), such fellows on acquiring a permanent job at other institute, will be allowed to transfer the fellowship and he can draw only research grant and overhead charges. The fellow should intimate to SERB about his permanent position immediately subsequently he can request for approval for change of host institute at a new institute within one month of shifting to new institute by submitting NOCs from both institution and appointment letter with detailed terms of references/conditions and the F.Y papers till the last date of working at earlier institute. The same is applicable for those fellows who want to transfer their fellowship to other Institute but without getting a permanent position. | - However, if a Ramanujan Fellow who is availing the fellowship (first sanction order issued after 31.12.2018), gets a permanent, tenure track or contractual position at other institute, then he/she will become in-eligible to receive the Ramanujan grant in total (as per the terms and conditions in the latest O.M. dated 01-01-2019) subject to final settlement and closure of the fellowship which is the mandatory requirement of this fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme

answer: The duly filled in application form along with prescribed documents can be submitted with the nearest branch office of NSIC. Details of NSIC offices are available on www.nsic.co.in.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: How the limit is sanctioned for procurement of material on credit?
answer: A limit is sanctioned keeping in view the raw materials requirements of the unit, financial position of the unit and available security of equivalent value in the form of bank guarantee.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Whether there is any ceiling of the limit to be sanctioned under the Scheme?
answer: Maximum exposure to a single unit under the scheme is ₹1000 Lakhs in case of manufacturing unit and ₹600 lakhs in case of service unit. Maximum exposure to an Infrastructure unit will be ₹500 lakhs whether individual or group. The ceiling for maximum exposure to all associate/sister concerns or connected accounts belonging to a ‘GROUP’ is fixed at ₹2000 lakh for manufacturing units, ₹1500 Lakh for service units and ₹500 Lakh for Infrastructure unit.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What is the validity of the limits sanctioned under the Scheme?
answer: One year. Thereafter, the limit can be renewed for one year provided conduct of the account was satisfactory during last year.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: How does NSIC provide credit support to MSMEs for procurement of raw materials?
answer: The unit has to submit proforma invoice/ original invoice/ material receipt note with the specific request to release the payment. The maximum assistance is provided upto 95% of the Bank Guarantee value.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Whether payment is released to the MSME?

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What are the benefits to MSMEs under the Raw Material Assistance Scheme?

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar
question: How much monetary reward is given under this scheme to gold medal winners?
answer: Under this scheme, each NCC cadet who is selected as a gold medal recipient is awarded a monetary prize of ₹3,000/- in recognition of their outstanding performance during training.

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar
question: What is the amount of reward provided to silver medal-winning cadets?

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar
question: How many NCC cadets are selected annually for the gold and silver medal rewards?

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar

scheme_name: Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Who Is Eligible To Apply?
answer: Indian nationals working abroad as Post-doctoral fellows/Scientists in any area of Life Sciences & Biotechnology, Bio-Engineering, Health Care (human and animal), Agriculture and Veterinary Biotechnology, Bio- Energy and allied areas are eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Are Overseas Citizens Of India Eligible To Apply?
answer: No, overseas citizens of India are not eligible to apply

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: How Many Years Of Post-Doctoral Experience Do I Require To Apply?
answer: A minimum of three years of post-doctoral experience in overseas laboratories is required for applying.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Can I Apply If I Have Already Returned To India?
answer: Yes, you can apply for this fellowship if you have already returned to India provided it is less than a year (2 years for women candidates) as on the closing date of advertisement. However, if you have secured a permanent position in India during this period, you can not apply for the fellowship

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Will My Research Experience After Returning To India Be Taken Into Account?
answer: No, only the research experience abroad would be counted.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: From Which Date On My Postdoctoral Experience Will Be Considered?
answer: Postdoctoral experience will be counted from the date of your joining as Post-doctoral fellow after your Ph. D degree has been awarded.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: If My Postdoctoral Experience Is Just Short Of One Month As On The Last Date Of Application Then, Can I Apply?
answer: No, in that case you are not eligible.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Can I Apply For The Fellowship If I Already Have A Job/ Position In India After My Return From Overseas?
answer: No, in that case you are not eligible

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Is There Any Age Bar For Applying?
answer: The upper age limit for applying is 45 years as on last date of receiving applications.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Will Experience In Industry Be Counted As Research Experience?
answer: Any research experience (post-PhD/post-MD or equivalent) regardless of the type of organization where it was carried out would be considered.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: . Am I Eligible To Apply In Two Different Schemes Simultaneously?
answer: Yes, you can apply for two different schemes simultaneously. But upon selection you need to choose only one fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Do I Need A Host Institute In India While Applying For RLS Fellowship?
answer: Yes, you need to choose a host institute/university/ industry in India where you would like to carry out your research during the tenure of the fellowship. The forwarding should be from Head of the Institution like Registrar/Vice Chancellor/ Director/Dean Research (as the case may be). Forwardal from the Head of the division will not be considered.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Can My Application Be Forwarded By Two Different Host Institutes?
answer: You can submit your nomination through single host institute only. However, host institute can nominate more than one candidate.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: What Would Be My Professional Status In The Host Institute Once I Join As RLS Fellow?
answer: Your position will be temporary only, however, Department encourages the host institutions to treat the fellow at par with faculty- Assistant Professor/Scientist D level, for the facilities like medical benefits, etc. from the institution's resources. In addition, the host institute may also allow you to take Ph.D/dissertation students.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: What Will Be The Duration Of Fellowship?
answer: The duration of the fellowship will be for a period of three years. In exceptional cases, the duration of the award may be extended by another two years after a fresh appraisal. Those who have already been absorbed as permanent faculty during the tenure will not be considered for extension.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: What Is The Amount Of Fellowship That Is Provided To RLS Fellows?
answer: A consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,00,000/- p.m. (consolidated) is | provided to the Ramalingaswami fellows upon selection after joining their respective host institutes. In addition, a House Rent Allowance of Rs. 18,500/- p.m. is given to fellows.

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Is There Any Research/ Contingent Grant Provided?
answer: A research/contingency grant of Rs. 13.00 lakh/year for purchase the of consumables, minor equipment, domestic travel, engaging manpower, and other contingent expenditures to be incurred for the implementation of the research proposal would be provided to the Ramalingaswami fellows. Institutional overhead Rs. 50,000/ year is also provided

scheme_name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
question: Is The Fellowship Taxable?
answer: The fellowship is taxable as per Govt. of India rules. For any matter related to the tax, the Department dealing with tax related matters may be contacted directly.

question: Can I submit the application online, or is it necessary to visit the District Industries Centre in person?

scheme_name: 'Rent Subsidy for Sales Emporia Established by Handicrafts / Micro & Small Industries Emporium' under 'Marketing And Publicity'
question: What steps are involved in the application receipt process after submission?

scheme_name: 'Rent Subsidy for Sales Emporia Established by Handicrafts / Micro & Small Industries Emporium' under 'Marketing And Publicity'
question: How long does it take to process and approve an application under the scheme?

scheme_name: 'Rent Subsidy for Sales Emporia Established by Handicrafts / Micro & Small Industries Emporium' under 'Marketing And Publicity'

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: If my institution focuses on research related to official statistics, what minimum staffing capability is required regarding statisticians, economists, and social scientists?
answer: The institution must have qualified statisticians, economists, and social scientists on its staff.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: If I have already received assistance for presenting a research paper abroad during this current financial year, can I still submit a separate request for this type of grant?
answer: An applicant official will not be recommended for more than one proposal for Travel Grant Assistance during the current financial year if the purpose is presenting their paper abroad.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: What specific areas of statistical inquiry are ineligible for funding, particularly regarding the theoretical nature of the research work?
answer: The proposals relating strictly to pure theoretical research in statistics are not eligible for financial assistance.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: For an officer seeking travel grants, must the topic of the paper being presented at the international conference be directly related to the specific duties and responsibilities of the officer?
answer: Yes, the purpose of the visit must be directly related to the area of work of the concerned officer.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: What is the minimum operational history required for a professional or research institution working in the field of official statistics to be considered eligible for grant assistance?
answer: The professional or research institution or organization must have been engaged in the field of official statistics for a minimum period of three (3) years.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: When submitting a proposal for travel funds to an international statistical conference, what official proof is required to demonstrate that my paper has been accepted for presentation?
answer: You must provide appropriate documentary evidence confirming the acceptance of the paper for presentation by the agencies organizing the international statistical conference, seminar, or workshop.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: Are all proposals concerning statistics research eligible for funding, or are there specific types of academic activities that are specifically excluded from financial assistance?
answer: Proposals for holding annual meetings of statistical associations or societies will not be eligible for financial assistance.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: If the Project Director or certain experts are regular, salaried employees of the applicant institution, can their existing salaries be covered or charged to the scheme's budget during the project duration?
answer: The salary of the Project Director or Experts, if they are already working as regular employees of the institute, cannot be charged from the project cost during the project period.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: What are the mandatory governmental permissions, such as clearance from the Ministry of External Affairs and the Ministry of Home Affairs, that I must secure before submitting my application for travel assistance?
answer: All necessary clearances must have been obtained, including political clearance from the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), and Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA) clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), wherever required.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: If my organization is seeking a Grant-in-Aid specifically for hosting a National or International Seminar, Conference, or Workshop on official statistics, what status must the organization hold?
answer: For the purpose of Grant-in-Aid for National and International Seminars, Conferences, or Workshops, the institution or organization shall be registered as "not-for-profit" to be eligible for assistance under this Scheme.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: When applying for assistance to present a technical paper internationally, is it acceptable if the paper was developed solely through the officer's independent choice or private endeavor?
answer: No, the technical paper must have been submitted through the proper official channel for the event and not solely out of the officer's own volition.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: Since various types of expenses are covered by the scheme, is financial assistance provided for the acquisition of new infrastructure or permanent assets related to the project?
answer: No, financial assistance is explicitly not available for the purpose of incurring any capital expenditure.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: Are there specific government employees or academic personnel who are eligible to seek financial assistance under the Travel Grants Assistance component of the scheme?
answer: Travel Grants Assistance is exclusively available for officials of the Central Government, Central autonomous institutions, or university personnel.

scheme_name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
question: If an official receives a direct invitation from the host organization to attend an international event, should this invitation be addressed only to the individual officer, or to a higher authority?
answer: An official invitation must be available from the host organization, and it must be addressed to the officer's administrative Ministry, Department, or Organization.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Who are eligible beneficiaries?
answer: Women, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and general category members of milk-producing cooperative societies are eligible.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Is membership in a cooperative society mandatory?
answer: Yes, applicants must be members of a milk cooperative society. Non-members can become eligible by joining the society and paying a membership fee of ₹25.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: What is the minimum age for membership?
answer: Applicants must be 18 years or older.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: What types of animals can be purchased under the scheme?
answer: Applicants can purchase cows (minimum 12 liters/day milk yield) or buffaloes (minimum 10 liters/day milk yield).

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: What is the minimum number of animals to be purchased?
answer: A minimum of two animals is required.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Is it mandatory to take a loan to avail the subsidy?
answer: Yes, taking a loan is compulsory to receive the subsidy.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Where can applicants get the application form?
answer: From the milk cooperative society or the nearest District Cooperative Bank.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Who certifies the application?
answer: The Committee Secretary certifies the application after verifying details.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
question: Who provides recommendations for the application?
answer: The Manager/Chief Manager of the Milk Producers Cooperative Union Ltd. and the Assistant Director of Dairy provide recommendations after scrutiny.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: How do I create an account and begin the registration process on the application portal?
answer: To create your account, visit the PIPDIC website at https://pipdic.in/, click "Login", and then select the "New customer" link. Enter a unique username, your email address, a secure password, and the Captcha code, then click "Register" to complete the registration process.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What is the purpose of the One-Time Password verification during the login process?
answer: The OTP is a security measure sent to your registered email address to verify your identity and ensure that only authorized users can access your account. You must enter this OTP and click "Login" to proceed to your customer dashboard.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What information am I required to provide when updating my profile after successful login?
answer: Upon logging in, you must access the "Edit Profile" option in the top right corner of your dashboard and complete all required profile details as requested by the system. These details are necessary for the loan application processing and verification purposes.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What documents and information should I prepare before starting my loan application?
answer: Before beginning your loan application, gather all Know Your Customer (KYC) documents and supporting documents as specified in the application checklist. Additionally, prepare detailed biodata information for the Promoter, Partner, or Director, as you will need to upload these documents during the application process.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: Where can I access the loan application form once I have completed my profile setup?
answer: After completing your profile update, navigate to the "Applications" tab on your customer dashboard to access the loan application form section.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What is included in the checklist that appears before I can proceed with the loan application?
answer: The pop-up checklist displays the General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms applicable to your loan. You must carefully review this information and confirm that you have gathered all necessary documents before proceeding.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What declaration must I read and agree to before submitting my loan application?
answer: You must read the comprehensive declaration within the application form, which covers confirmation of true and accurate information provided, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification and investigation by PIPDIC officials.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: How many steps does the loan application form typically contain, and what should I do if I need to pause my application?
answer: The loan application is structured as a multi-step form across several stages. While the document does not specify a save-and-resume feature, you should complete all mandatory fields across each required step before proceeding to the next stage.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What is the process for uploading Know Your Customer and supporting documents after submitting my application details?
answer: After completing the main application form submission, the system will redirect you to enter your Promoter, Partner, or Director biodata information in a multi-step process. For each required document field, click the "Choose File" button, select the appropriate file from your computer in the format specified by the portal, and upload it to the system.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What are the applicable application fees for different loan amounts under this scheme?
answer: For loan amounts up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. For loan amounts exceeding ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: How do I make the payment for my application fee, and what happens after successful payment?
answer: Once your application and biodata submission is complete, proceed to pay the applicable application fee. If you select online payment, the system will automatically redirect you to a payment summary page where you can verify your details and complete the payment transaction.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: What should I do with the payment receipt I receive after paying my application fee?
answer: Upon successful payment, a receipt for your application fee is generated automatically. You can print this receipt or save it to your computer as a PDF for future reference and record-keeping purposes.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
question: How can I track the status of my submitted loan application after submission?
answer: You can monitor your application status by clicking the "View My Application" link on your customer dashboard and selecting your relevant loan application from the drop-down menu. Your application will initially display a status such as "UNDER REVIEW" as it progresses through processing.

scheme_name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization

answer: You can contact the Managing Director at the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited office located at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. The office phone number is 0413-2334361, and you can email your queries to info@pipdic.com. The General Manager (Administration) is also available via mobile contact at 9894653835. scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand

answer: Eligible children receive free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
question: Up to which class do children receive free education under this scheme?
answer: Children are eligible for free education and benefits up to Class 8 in private schools.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
question: When are applications invited under the scheme?
answer: Applications are generally invited through advertisements in February-March each year.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
question: How can parents/guardians apply for this scheme?

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand

answer: After entering their address on the portal, parents/guardians can view a list of schools in their ward and must select the nearest school.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
question: What should be done after submitting the online application?
answer: A printout of the application, along with photocopies of required documents, must be submitted to the office of the concerned Deputy Education Officer or Block Education Officer.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
question: Who verifies the documents submitted by applicants?
answer: All documents are verified by a committee at the development block level.

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
